text:
Tests

# test_c1_report (AC-9, FR-D2, FR-D3, FR-D4): on syntheticRows20 with known effects, the gate's parts (i) and (ii) with their
# robustness, the margin, win-back (H20-3), H20-4, H20-5, H20-7, the clean contrasts of H20-8, the inert-bridge flag and the
# core measures (FR-D5) are recovered exactly (one noise draw per seed is shared by every arm, so paired differences are
# exact: p 1/256 over 8 boards, 1/32 over 5); the gate fails on either part, the flag fires when bridges do nothing and the
# gate passes; missing cells are refused; partBSummaries recovers H20-6 on synthetic part-b rows; the report names every
# C1_PLAN item and c1.png is written; rows read back from CSV give the same summary
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV, writeCSV
from explRL.bridge_write import figC1, syntheticPartB, syntheticRows20, writeC1

close = lambda a, b: abs(a - b) < 1e-9
rows = syntheticRows20()
assert len(rows) == 54 and len(planned20()) == 54                     # 23 new with liars, 15 clean, 16 reused
S = c1Summaries(rows + [dict(rows[0], seed=1890, level='bridge1|independent')], nboot=200)   # a pilot row is left out
G, H = S['gate'], S['hyp']
assert S['boards'] == 54 and G['metric'] == 'honestPooled' and G['passes']
# part (i): bridge1 - colonyGuards = lead - cost + back = 0.141 on all 8 boards, so p = 1/256
assert close(G['i']['estimate'], 0.171 - 0.10 + 0.07) and G['i']['n'] == 8 and G['i']['p'] == 1 / 256 and G['i']['passes']
# part (ii): the lead 0.171, the bar half of it, the per-board margin 0.141 - 0.0855
assert close(G['ii']['lead']['estimate'], 0.171) and close(G['ii']['bar'], 0.0855) and close(G['ii']['estimate'], 0.141 - 0.0855)
assert G['ii']['holds'] and G['ii']['p'] == 1 / 256 and G['ii']['ci'][0] <= G['ii']['estimate'] + 1e-12 <= G['ii']['ci'][1] + 2e-12
# robustness on welfareHonest (1.3 x honestPooled in the synthetic rows): same signs
assert G['robust'] == dict(i=True, ii=True) and close(G['welfareHonest']['i']['estimate'], 1.3 * 0.141)
# H20-3: coupling cost 0.10, bridge gain 0.07, win-back 0.7 (> 0.5), the per-board margin 0.07 - 0.05 with p 1/32
h3 = H['H20_3']
assert close(h3['couplingCost']['estimate'], 0.10) and close(h3['bridgeGain']['estimate'], 0.07) and close(h3['winBack'], 0.7)
assert close(h3['estimate'], 0.02) and h3['p'] == 1 / 32 and h3['n'] == 5 and h3['supported']
assert h3['winBackCi'][0] <= 0.7 + 1e-9 and h3['winBackCi'][1] >= 0.7 - 1e-9
# H20-4: bridge2 - bridge1 = 0.01 < 0.25 x 0.10, margin -0.015 (p for < 0: 1/32)
assert close(H['H20_4']['secondBridge']['estimate'], 0.01) and close(H['H20_4']['estimate'], -0.015)
assert H['H20_4']['p'] == 1 / 32 and H['H20_4']['supported']
# H20-5: false-relay share 0.3 against 0.1 with guarding bridges; honestPooled bridgeGuard - bridge1 = 0.005
assert close(H['H20_5']['estimate'], 0.2) and H['H20_5']['p'] == 1 / 32 and H['H20_5']['supported']
assert close(H['H20_5']['pooled']['estimate'], 0.005)
# H20-7: contamination per coupled arm, and bridge1 - bridgeGuard = 0.05
assert {a: round(v[0], 9) for a, v in H['H20_7']['perArm'].items()} == dict(coupled=0.0, bridge1=0.08, bridge2=0.08, bridgeGuard=0.03)
assert close(H['H20_7']['guarding']['estimate'], 0.05) and H['H20_7']['guarding']['n'] == 5
# H20-8: clean boards, coupled - squads = -0.03 and bridge1 - squads = -0.01 (p for < 0: 1/32), welfareHonest 1.3 times
c8 = H['H20_8']['contrasts']
assert set(c8) == {'coupled - squads', 'bridge1 - squads'} and set(H['H20_8']['perArm']) == {'squads', 'coupled', 'bridge1'}
assert close(c8['coupled - squads']['honestPooled']['estimate'], -0.03) and close(c8['bridge1 - squads']['honestPooled']['estimate'], -0.01)
assert close(c8['coupled - squads']['welfareHonest']['estimate'], -0.039)
assert all(t['p'] == 1 / 32 and t['n'] == 5 for d in c8.values() for t in d.values())
assert S['inert'] == dict(estimate=h3['bridgeGain']['estimate'], fires=False)
# per arm: boards, advantage over colonyGuards, core measures equal their definitions on the synthetic columns
A = S['arms']
assert {a: v['boards'] for a, v in A.items()} == dict(squads=8, colonyGuards=8, coupled=5, bridge1=8, bridge2=5, bridgeGuard=5)
assert A['colonyGuards']['advantage'] is None and close(A['coupled']['advantage']['estimate'], 0.071)
core = A['bridge1']['core']
assert core['boards'] == 8 and close(core['gullibility'], 6 / 1920) and close(core['suppression'], 0.5) and close(core['contestsPerLie'], 0.5)
assert core['timeToContest'] == 2.0 and close(core['guardedLies'], 0.4) and close(core['errorCorr'], 1 / 3) and core['tokPerSolved'] == 60000.0
assert 0 < core['dol'] < 1 and close(core['crossContamination'], 0.08) and A['bridge1']['coreClean']['boards'] == 5 and A['bridge2']['coreClean'] is None
assert close(A['bridge1']['columns']['falseRelayShare'], 0.3) and A['squads']['columns']['bridgeRelays'] == 0.0
# the inert-bridge flag: a small coupling cost and bridges that do nothing; the gate passes, the flag fires
Si = c1Summaries(syntheticRows20(cost=0.03, back=-0.005), nboot=50)
assert Si['gate']['passes'] and Si['inert']['fires'] and close(Si['inert']['estimate'], -0.005) and not Si['hyp']['H20_3']['supported']
# part (ii) fails (bridge1 - colonyGuards 0.021 < 0.0855) while part (i) passes; then part (i) fails too
Sf = c1Summaries(syntheticRows20(cost=0.15, back=0.0), nboot=50)
assert Sf['gate']['i']['passes'] and not Sf['gate']['ii']['holds'] and not Sf['gate']['passes'] and not Sf['inert']['fires']
Sf = c1Summaries(syntheticRows20(cost=0.25, back=0.0), nboot=50)
assert not Sf['gate']['i']['passes'] and Sf['gate']['i']['p'] == 1.0 and not Sf['gate']['passes']
# every planned cell, clean cells included, must be present
for drop in ('bridge1|clean', 'colonyGuards|independent'):
    try:
        c1Summaries([r for r in rows if not (r['level'] == drop and r['seed'] == 1803)], nboot=10)
        raise AssertionError(drop)
    except ValueError as e:
        assert 'missing' in str(e) and drop in str(e)
# part b: each run's difference is exactly gain4 - gain1 = 0.044 (p 1/256); honest losses 0.04 and 0.08
B = partBSummaries(syntheticPartB())
h6 = B['H20_6']
assert close(h6['estimate'], 0.044) and h6['p'] == 1 / 256 and h6['n'] == 8 and h6['positive'] == 8
assert close(h6['honestLoss_squads4'], 0.04) and close(h6['honestLoss_oneBoard'], 0.08) and B['phase17'] == {4: 0.078, 32: 0.006}
assert close(h6['gain_squads4'] - h6['gain_oneBoard'], 0.044) and close(B['runs']['warm']['squads4']['gain'], 0.0)
assert partBSummaries(syntheticPartB(gain4=0.0, gain1=0.03))['H20_6']['p'] == 1.0
try:
    partBSummaries([r for r in syntheticPartB() if r['level'] != 'r17mix_s3|n32liar'])
    raise AssertionError('missing part b rows')
except ValueError as e:
    assert 'r17mix_s3|n32liar' in str(e)
# the report, the figure, and a CSV round trip
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    writeC1(Path(d) / 'report.md', S, dict(planHash='x', commit='y', mode='quick'), partB=B)
    figC1(d, S)
    txt = (Path(d) / 'report.md').read_text()
    assert (Path(d) / 'c1.png').stat().st_size > 10_000 and '**Gate C1: passes**' in txt and 'does not fire' in txt
    assert all(f'- {k}:' in txt for k in C1_PLAN) and all(f'H20-{i}' in txt for i in (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)) and 'gullibility' in txt
    writeC1(Path(d) / 'b.md', None, dict(mode='partb'), partB=B)
    assert 'Part b' in (Path(d) / 'b.md').read_text() and '## Gate C1' not in (Path(d) / 'b.md').read_text()
    writeCSV(rows, Path(d) / 'runs.csv')
    S2 = c1Summaries(readCSV(Path(d) / 'runs.csv'), nboot=200)
assert close(S2['gate']['ii']['estimate'], G['ii']['estimate']) and close(S2['arms']['bridge1']['core']['dol'], core['dol'])

import numpy as np
from explRL.llm_compare import *
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig

# a numpy cell of each task, with and without a liar, on every channel
for task in ('forage', 'board'):
    for ch in ('none', 'blackboard', 'messages', 'hierarchical'):
        r = runNumpy(LLMConfig(task=task, channel=ch, N=4, turns=30, world=dict(solveRate=0.4) if task == 'board' else {}), 500)[0]
        assert np.isfinite(r['welfare']) and r['tEnd'] > 0
    r = runNumpy(LLMConfig(task=task, channel='blackboard', N=4, nLiar=1, turns=30), 500)[0]
    assert np.isfinite(r['welfareHonest'])
# fixed world time (B-numpy): a Phase 8-style row (welfare = team total, perAgentSecond), events or rounds, squads
for proto, w0 in (('events', 0.0), ('rounds', 5.0)):
    rr = runNumpy(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=8, protocol=proto, window=w0, squads=4, beta=1.0,
                            world=dict(tStay=5.0, T=120.0)), 700)[0]
    assert {'perAgentSecond', 'coverage', 'diversity', 'teamWelfare', 'teamRate_0', 'homeShare'} <= set(rr)
    assert abs(rr['welfare'] - rr['teamWelfare']) < 1e-9 and abs(rr['perAgentSecond'] - rr['welfare'] / (8 * 120)) < 1e-12
# with beta = 0 and d = 0 the squads and the round protocol change nothing
a = runNumpy(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=8, world=dict(tStay=5.0, T=120.0)), 701)[0]
b = runNumpy(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=8, protocol='rounds', window=0.0, squads=4, beta=0.0, world=dict(tStay=5.0, T=120.0)), 701)[0]
import json
nanEq = lambda d: json.dumps({k: d[k] for k in sorted(d) if k != 'homeShare'}, default=str)
assert nanEq(a) == nanEq(b)
r = runNumpy(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=50), 501)[0]
assert np.isfinite(r['diversity']) and 'calls' not in r
# 50 turns span under two patch moves (about 60 s of world time), so recovery is undefined; 100 turns define it
assert r['tEnd'] < 80 and np.isnan(r['rmrt']) and np.isfinite(runNumpy(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=100), 501)[0]['rmrt'])
tr = runNumpyCell(dict(study='roundsNumpy', factor='roundsNumpy', level='events', N=8, seed=700, runner='numpy',
                       cfg=LLMConfig(N=8, channel='blackboard', world=dict(tStay=5.0, T=60.0)).asDict()))[0]
assert (tr['study'], tr['level'], tr['seed']) == ('roundsNumpy', 'events', 700)
row = runNumpyCell(dict(study='numpy', factor='main', level='forage', N=2, seed=500, runner='numpy',
                        cfg=LLMConfig(N=2, turns=10).asDict()))[0]
assert row['runner'] == 'numpy' and row['task'] == 'forage' and row['N'] == 2

# ranks with average ties; Spearman
assert list(rankAvg([3, 1, 2, 2])) == [4, 1, 2.5, 2.5]
assert spearman([1, 2, 3, 4], [10, 20, 30, 40]) == 1.0 and spearman([1, 2, 3], [3, 2, 1]) == -1.0
assert np.isnan(spearman([1, 1, 1], [1, 2, 3]))

# compareNumpy recovers a known rho on synthetic rows: LLM = monotone transform of numpy (rho 1) and reversed (rho -1)
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
cells = [(c, n) for c in ('none', 'blackboard', 'messages', 'hierarchical') for n in (1, 2, 4, 8)]
base = {cell: k for k, cell in enumerate(cells)}
def rows(f, noise):
    return [dict(task='board', channel=c, N=n, seed=s, welfare=f(base[(c, n)]) + noise * rng.standard_normal())
            for (c, n) in cells for s in range(5)]
np_rows = rows(lambda k: k, 0.01)
res = compareNumpy(rows(lambda k: np.exp(k / 4), 0.001), np_rows, nboot=200)['board']
assert res['rho'] == 1.0 and res['cells'] == 16 and res['seeds'] == 5 and res['ci'][0] > 0.9
assert compareNumpy(rows(lambda k: -k, 0.01), np_rows, nboot=200)['board']['rho'] == -1.0
noisy = compareNumpy(rows(lambda k: 0.0, 5.0), np_rows, nboot=200)['board']
assert abs(noisy['rho']) < 0.9 and noisy['ci'][0] < noisy['rho'] < noisy['ci'][1]

# the threat mix: the same draws for every arm and seed at a step; arm 3's lifetimes are arm 2's; groups hold the step's boards
from explRL.rl19_grid import FIXED4, VARIED, RL19Config, rl19Config
from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17Config

a2, a3 = RL19Config('m', 'o', threat=VARIED, mixN=((16, 1.0),), trainSeed=3), RL19Config('m', 'o', threat=FIXED4, mixN=((16, 1.0),))

    d2, d3 = threatDraws(a2, s), threatDraws(a3, s)

    assert {n for n, _ in d3} == {4} and {n for n, _ in d2} <= {0, 4, 6} and {L for _, L in d2} <= {15, 30}
    gs = stepGroups(a2, s)

    assert all(x[0] == 16 and (x[1], x[2]) in set(d2) for x in gs) and len({k for x in gs for k in x[4]}) == 32

assert stepGroups(RL17Config('m', 'o', mixN=((4, 0.5), (8, 0.5)), liarShare=0.25), 2) == \
    [(N, nl, None, sd, [(N, nl, b) for b in range(len(sd))]) for N, nl, sd in boardGroups(RL17Config('m', 'o', mixN=((4, 0.5), (8, 0.5)), liarShare=0.25), 2)]
assert world19(RL17Config('m', 'o')) == {} == world19(RL19Config('m', 'o'))
assert world19(RL19Config('m', 'o', contestSlots='all', halfLife=2, sharePenalty=0.5), 15) == dict(contestSlots='all', halfLife=2.0, sharePenalty=0.5, life=15)
for bad in (RL19Config('m', 'o', scheme='contest'), RL19Config('m', 'o', contestSlots='guards'), RL19Config('m', 'o', haltAnswers=3)):
    try:
        check19(bad)
        raise AssertionError(bad)
    except ValueError:

# test_penalty, its trainer half (AC-4): the answer halt fires after exactly 3 steps in a row below a third of the reference (a
# step at exactly a third does not count), not before, and not when the streak breaks; the invalid and KL halts come first
from types import SimpleNamespace
cfg = RL19Config('m', 'o', haltAnswers=3, haltKLRun=2)
H = lambda *r: [dict(step=i + 1, invalid=0.0, kl=0.0, answerRatio=x) for i, x in enumerate(r)]
assert haltReason19(H(0.2, 0.2), cfg) is None and haltReason19(H(0.5, 0.2, 0.2), cfg) is None
assert haltReason19(H(0.5, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2), cfg) == "answers per board below a third of the warm start's for 3 steps (steps 2-4)"
assert haltReason19(H(0.2, 0.2, 1 / 3), cfg) is None and haltReason19(H(0.2, 0.4, 0.2, 0.2), cfg) is None
assert haltReason19(H(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), RL19Config('m', 'o')) is None                 # off at the defaults
kl = [dict(h, kl=0.9) for h in H(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)]
assert haltReason19(kl, cfg).startswith('mean KL') and haltReason19(kl, RL17Config('m', 'o', haltKLRun=2)) == haltReason(kl, RL17Config('m', 'o', haltKLRun=2))
# answerStats: honest submissions over the step's boards against the table for their board types
board = lambda n, life: SimpleNamespace(submits=[(0.0, i, 0, None, 'wrong') for i in range(n)], life=life)
gs = [(SimpleNamespace(N=16, nLiar=4), SimpleNamespace(boards=[board(6, 15.0), board(4, 15.0)])),
      (SimpleNamespace(N=16, nLiar=0), SimpleNamespace(boards=[board(3, 30.0)]))]
cw = RL19Config('m', 'o', haltAnswers=3, world=(('warmAnswers', (((16, 4, 15), 6.0), ((16, 0, 30), 9.0))),))
st = answerStats(cw, gs)                      # honest: slots >= nLiar, so 2 + 0 + 3 = 5 answers against 6 + 6 + 9
assert st == dict(answers=5, answerRef=21.0, answerRatio=5 / 21) and answerStats(RL19Config('m', 'o'), gs) == {}


# records across steps: take, commit, save and a resume give the same records; a rolled-back step (take without commit) adds nothing
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    book = RecordBook(d)
    fake = NS(netByAgent=lambda: np.arange(4.0), nAgents=4, contestLog=None)
    for step in range(1, 4):
        recs = book.take([(4, 0, 0), (4, 1, 0)], 4)
        if step == 2:                                 # a step played, rolled back and played again: the replay starts afresh
            for r in recs:
                r.addBoard(fake, range(1, 4))
            recs = book.take([(4, 0, 0), (4, 1, 0)], 4)
            assert len(recs[0].boards) == 1
        for r in recs:
            r.addBoard(fake, range(1, 4))
        book.commit()
        book.save(step)
    book.take([(4, 9, 0)], 4)[0].addBoard(fake, range(1, 4))      # a key played at one step only (another liar count) ...
    book.commit()
    book.take([(4, 0, 0)], 4)
    book.commit()
    assert len(book.state[(4, 9, 0)]['boards']) == 1                # ... keeps its record when later steps do not draw it
    again = RecordBook(d, 3).take([(4, 0, 0)], 4)[0]
    assert len(again.boards) == 3 and again.boards[2][3]['answers'] == 3.0 and again.line(0).count('board ') == 3
    assert again.line(1) == book.take([(4, 0, 0)], 4)[0].line(1)
    for _ in range(3):
        again.addBoard(fake, range(4))
    assert again.boards == []                              # six boards: the sequence ends and the record resets
    try:
        RecordBook(d, 5)
        raise AssertionError('resumed without records')
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass

Contest credit on a bridge board
Two changes to contest.ContestLog, built only on a bridge board with contest credit (BridgeBoardEnv.reset):

Relayed lies (P20-12, FR-A9). A relay is posted under the bridge’s slot, but the value is its source’s. lies reads each value’s first poster through relayLog, looked up when a contest is judged (the relay’s own onShare comes before relayLog is written). A relayed liar’s value is a lie on the receiving squad’s board, and a true post against it is a contest.
Border contests (P23-8, kept by the user on 2026-11-12). A true holder’s mirror post while the mirror shows a false value that a liar posted there first. Its watchers are the receiving squad’s honest agents without the clue that were shown a lie of the slot before any true value: on their own board after a relay, or on the mirror for the pair’s bridge (the user chose this over bridges only and a flat payment, 2026-11-12). Each watcher’s later correct solve pays the contester as any contest does: 0.5, halved every halfLife turns of the lie’s lead.

def BridgeContestLog(
    board, liarSlots, contestSlots, halfLife:float=4.0
):
ContestLog on a bridge board (T5a; P20-12, and P23-8 as the user kept it). A relayed value is its source poster’s, looked up when a contest is judged (relayLog is written after the relay’s own onShare), so a relayed liar’s value is a lie on the receiving squad’s board and contesting it there pays, as any contest. A border contest: the first true mirror post, by an honest holder, while the mirror shows a false value a liar posted there first and no true value (one per slot, so repeated posts cannot farm it). Its watchers are the receiving squad’s honest agents without the clue that were shown that mirror lie before any true value of the slot: on their own board through a relay, or, for the pair’s bridge, on the mirror. A watcher’s later correct solve pays the border contester as any contest pays (the user, 2026-11-12). Board watchers (sawLie) and border watchers (sawBorder) are kept apart.

Tests

# test_bridge19_world (T5a, T5b; P19-1, P19-8, P19-9): bridge1 in two squads or more, a single squad unbridged; Gate C1's
# record sets the world; every arm's config builds a bridge board, with BridgeContestLog under contest credit
from explRL.bridge_board import BridgeBoardEnv, checkBridge
from explRL.clue_grid import BOARD, CLUE_SETTINGS
from explRL.clue_roll import boardFactory
from explRL.contest import ContestLog
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig
from explRL.rl19_bridge import *
from explRL.rl19_grid import ARMS19, RL19_PLAN, rl19Config, worldFor19
from explRL.rl19_step import check19, world19
assert dict(BRIDGE19) == dict(couple=0.25, bridges=1) and RL19_PLAN['gates']['C1'] is GATE_C1
assert worldFor19(GATE_C1) == RL19_PLAN['world'] == 'bridges' and worldFor19(dict(GATE_C1, passed=False)) == 'squads'
assert worldFor19(dict(GATE_C1, inertFired=True)) == 'squads' and worldFor19(dict(GATE_C1, inertFired=True, userAcceptsBridges=True)) == 'bridges'
assert bridgeWorld19(dict(squads=4), 16) == dict(squads=4, couple=0.25, bridges=1) and bridgeWorld19(dict(squads=8), 8) == dict(squads=8)
assert bridgeWorld19((('r', 2), ('squads', 8)), 16) == (('r', 2), ('squads', 8), ('couple', 0.25), ('bridges', 1))
assert isBridge19(dict(scheme='contest', couple=0.25)) and isBridge19(dict(p19=True, couple=0.25))
assert not isBridge19(dict(scheme='individual', couple=0.25, bridges=1)) and not isBridge19(dict(scheme='contest'))   # C1's rows; unbridged


def lcfg(arm, S, nl, life=30):
    "A training board's LLMConfig as trainRL17 builds it (rl17_train's lcfg)."
    c = rl19Config(arm, 1, 'm', 'o', {}, S, plan=dict(RL19_PLAN, records=False))   # arm 4's records: P19-5, at the freeze
    check19(c)
    return c, LLMConfig(task='clue', channel=c.channel, N=16, nLiar=nl, turns=c.turns, model=c.model,
                        world={**{k: CLUE_SETTINGS[k] for k in BOARD}, 'scheme': c.scheme, **dict(c.world), **world19(c, life)})


for arm in ARMS19:
    for S in (4, 8):
        c, L = lcfg(arm, S, 6)
        w = dict(c.world)
        assert w['couple'] == 0.25 and w['bridges'] == 1 and 'bridgeGuard' not in w and checkBridge(L.world, 16, 6)
        bd = boardFactory(L)[0](900)
        assert isinstance(bd, BridgeBoardEnv) and len(bd.bridgeSet) == 16 // S
        assert type(bd.contestLog) is (BridgeContestLog if c.scheme == 'contest' else type(None))


# test_bridge19_contest (FR-A9; P20-12, P23-8): on a hand-built 16-agent board in two squads (arm 4: contest credit open to
# all), a liar's mirror lie, relayed by the bridge, is the liar's on the receiving board (a plain ContestLog sees no lie); a
# true holder's mirror post is a border contest whose watchers are the bridge and the receiving squad's agent shown the
# relay; the bridge's relay of the true value contests the relayed lie; that agent's correct solve pays both contesters; a relayed true value splits its credit (P20-12)
import json
from explRL.contest import preventionBonus
from explRL.contest_eval import _columns, contestColumns, refuses
_, L = lcfg('a19open', 8, 4)
bd = boardFactory(L)[0](901)
log, nS = bd.contestLog, bd.nSquads


def pick(bd, skip=()):
    "A coupled open subtask with an honest holder of its cross clue, a liar in the mirror squad and a watcher in its own."
    for k in sorted(bd.coupled):
        s, s2 = bd.coupled[k]
        hs = [h for h in bd.tasks[k].holders[1] if h >= bd.nLiar]
        liars = [i for i in range(bd.nLiar) if i % nS == s2]
        ws = [a for a in range(bd.nLiar, 16) if a % nS == s and a not in bd.bridgeSet and a not in bd.tasks[k].holders[1]]
        if k in bd.open and k not in skip and hs and liars and ws:
            return k, hs[0], liars[0], bd.bridges[s][0], ws[0]


k, h, liar, br, a = pick(bd)
p, tr = bd.tasks[k].task.clue(1)
fr, T = (tr + 1) % p, iter(x / 100 for x in range(1, 100))   # turns 0.01 apart: no subtask expires meanwhile
step = lambda i, act: bd.apply(i, act, next(T))
step(liar, ('share', (k, 1, fr)))                         # the lie on the mirror
step(br, ('wait', None))                                  # the bridge is shown it on its pair's mirror
step(br, ('share', (k, 1, fr)))                           # ... and relays it
assert bd.relayLog and bd.relayLog[-1][5][1] == liar and log.lies(k, 1)[0][1:] == (fr, liar) and ContestLog.lies(log, k, 1) == []
step(a, ('wait', None))                                   # a, in the receiving squad, is shown the relayed lie
assert set(log.sawBorder[(k, 1)]) == {br, a} and set(log.sawLie[(k, 1)]) == {a}   # the bridge saw the lie on the mirror only
step(h, ('share', (k, 1, tr)))                            # the true holder's mirror post: a border contest
c = log.contests[log.border[0]]
assert len(log.border) == 1 == len(log.contests) and (c.who, c.liar, c.lie) == (h, liar, fr) and set(c.watchers) == {br, a}
step(h, ('share', (k, 1, tr)))                            # a repeat true mirror post is no new border contest (no farming)
assert len(log.border) == 1 == len(log.contests)
step(br, ('share', (k, 1, tr)))                           # the bridge relays the true value: a contest against the relayed lie
c2 = log.contests[-1]
assert len(log.contests) == 2 and (c2.who, c2.liar, c2.lie) == (br, liar, fr) and set(c2.watchers) == {a}
step(a, ('open', k))
x = bd.tasks[k].task.x
step(a, ('submit', x))                                    # a's correct solve pays both contesters
assert [(q[1], q[2], q[3]) for q in log.paid] == [(h, a, k), (br, a, k)]
assert all(abs(q[5] - preventionBonus(cc.t_c - cc.t_l, log.H)) < 1e-12 for q, cc in zip(log.paid, (c, c2)))
assert log.earned(16)[h] > 0 and log.earned(16)[br] > 0
# the columns: relay-aware on this cell, plain for C1's (no Phase 19 marker)
C, P = contestColumns(L, bd), _columns(L, bd)
assert C['liarPosts'] == 1 and P['liarPosts'] == 0 and C['contests'] == 1 and P['contests'] == 0
assert C['borderContests'] == 1 and C['mirrorLies'] == 1 and json.loads(C['agentBorderContests'])[h] == 1
assert json.loads(C['agentShares']) == json.loads(P['agentShares']) and json.loads(C['agentShares'])[br] == 2
assert json.loads(C['agentContests'])[br] == 1 and json.loads(C['agentContests'])[h] == 0   # the contester is the real poster, as paid
assert C['liarFirst'] == 1 and C['uncorrected'] == 0 and P['liarFirst'] == 0 and C['misreport19'] != C['misreport19']   # relays only: NaN
assert not refuses(bd, a, k, x, 3)                        # P19-9: a coupled answer is exempt from enforceK
# a lie posted straight onto the receiving board (no relay) makes a board watcher, not a border watcher
k3, h3, liar3, br3, a3 = pick(bd, skip={k})
s3 = bd.coupled[k3][0]
p3, tr3 = bd.tasks[k3].task.clue(1)
own = next(i for i in range(bd.nLiar) if i % nS == s3)
step(own, ('share', (k3, 1, (tr3 + 1) % p3)))             # a liar of the receiving squad, on its own board
step(liar3, ('share', (k3, 1, (tr3 + 1) % p3)))           # the same false value on the mirror
step(a3, ('wait', None))
assert a3 in log.sawLie[(k3, 1)] and a3 not in log.sawBorder.get((k3, 1), {})
step(h3, ('share', (k3, 1, tr3)))
assert a3 not in log.contests[log.border[-1]].watchers and len(log.border) == 2
from explRL.bridge_grid import bridgeCheckCells           # P20-11's check runs in A1's world (p19): relay-aware columns too
assert all(isBridge19(c['cfg']['world']) for c in bridgeCheckCells())
# P20-12: a relayed true value's credit share goes half to the bridge, half to the first true poster on the mirror
k2, h2, _, br2, a2 = pick(bd, skip={k, k3})
p2, tr2 = bd.tasks[k2].task.clue(1)
step(h2, ('share', (k2, 1, tr2)))
step(br2, ('share', (k2, 1, tr2)))
before = bd.pending.copy()
step(a2, ('open', k2))
step(a2, ('submit', bd.tasks[k2].task.x))
got = bd.pending - before
assert not any(s[2] == k2 and s[3] == 0 for s in bd.shareLog)   # clue 1 is the only credited clue
assert abs(got[br2] - got[h2]) < 1e-12 and abs(got[br2] - bd.credit * bd.tasks[k2].value / 2) < 1e-12


# test_bridge19_step (T5a done-when): a recorded 16-agent bridged rollout (the fake Claude client, prompts kept) gives the
# step's longestBridge (at least the bridge's longest prompt, bridgePromptTokens) and relays per bridge turn; none unbridged
import math
from explRL.bridge_agents import bridgePromptTokens
from explRL.clue_policy import claudePolicy
from explRL.clue_roll import rollout
from explRL.colony_agents import scriptedFaults
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply
_, L = lcfg('a19contest', 4, 4)
pol = claudePolicy(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply)))
ro = rollout(L, [902], pol, scriptedFaults(L.world, 4), keepPrompts=True)
st = bridgeStepStats([(L, ro)])
assert set(st) == {'longestBridge', 'relaysPerBridgeTurn'} and st['longestBridge'] >= bridgePromptTokens(L, [902])['bridge'] > 0
assert math.isfinite(st['relaysPerBridgeTurn']) and st['relaysPerBridgeTurn'] == len(ro.boards[0].relayLog) / sum(
    1 for r in ro.boards[0].ledger if r[0] in ro.boards[0].bridgeSet)
L0 = LLMConfig.fromDict({**L.asDict(), 'world': {k: v for k, v in L.world.items() if k not in ('couple', 'bridges')}})
assert bridgeStepStats([(L0, rollout(L0, [902], pol, scriptedFaults(L0.world, 4), keepPrompts=True))]) == {}

                        valueOnly=True, tokenClip=True, maxLen=4096)

        assert all(x['cut'] == 0 and np.isfinite(x['klAll']) and 0 < x['longest'] <= 4096 for x in m)   # pilot v3's fix runs; nothing cut at 4096
        # Phase 18 Part B's fix: every token's k3 capped, so the logged KL (value tokens and all) can never exceed the cap
        ck = RL17Config(tiny, f'{d}/k', **{**kw, 'lr': 5e-2}, kl=0.04, lrFixed=5e-2, valueOnly=True, tokenClip=True, maxLen=4096,
                        klClamp=1e-4, haltKLRun=2)
        trainRL17(ck)

        assert all(x['kl'] <= 1e-4 + 1e-12 and x['klAll'] <= 1e-4 + 1e-12 for x in mk), mk
        # Phase 18: a step on the colony board (two holders, colluding liars) through `world`

# test_rl19_step (AC-5, flag train, tiny model, no download): one trainRL19 step at the defaults equals trainRL17's (metrics and
# final adapter); a Phase 19 step (contest credit, the threat mix, records, the penalty, the answer halt) in 16-agent squads
# (8 agents in squads of 4 on the Mac) runs, never trains a liar slot, logs the answer ratio, saves its records, resumes from them, and carries configHash19
import importlib.util
if all(importlib.util.find_spec(m) for m in ('transformers', 'peft', 'tokenizers')):   # the [train] extra; the docs build runs cells with imports and lacks it
    import json
    import tempfile
    import torch
    import explRL.rl17_train as T
    from explRL.rl19_grid import LIFETIMES, VARIED, RL19Config, configHash19
    from explRL.tiny_model import tinyModel
    from safetensors.torch import load_file
    _tr = T.trainingReturns
    noisy = lambda seed: (lambda r: (lambda ro, *a: _tr(ro, *a) + r.normal(size=np.shape(ro.returns))))(np.random.default_rng(seed))
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        tiny = tinyModel(d + '/tiny')
        kw = dict(steps=1, seedsPerStep=2, group=3, turns=3, ckptEvery=1, maxNew=24, lr=1e-3, haltRun=99)
        T.trainingReturns = noisy(0)

        T.trainingReturns = noisy(0)
        trainRL19(RL19Config(tiny, f'{d}/b', **kw))
        strip = lambda p: [{k: v for k, v in json.loads(x).items() if 'Seconds' not in k} for x in open(p)]
        assert strip(f'{d}/a/metrics.jsonl') == strip(f'{d}/b/metrics.jsonl')
        wa, wb = load_file(f'{d}/a/final/adapter_model.safetensors'), load_file(f'{d}/b/final/adapter_model.safetensors')
        assert wa.keys() == wb.keys() and all(torch.equal(wa[k], wb[k]) for k in wa)
        assert json.load(open(f'{d}/a/config.json'))['hash'] == json.load(open(f'{d}/b/config.json'))['hash']
        warm = tuple(((8, n, L), 30.0) for n in (0, 2, 3) for L in LIFETIMES)     # liars of 16 scaled to 8; high: every step is below a third
        c19 = RL19Config(tiny, f'{d}/c', **{**kw, 'seedsPerStep': 2, 'group': 2, 'turns': 2}, mixN=((8, 1.0),), scheme='contest',
                         contestSlots='all', threat=VARIED, records=True, sharePenalty=0.5, haltAnswers=2, maxLen=1024, microBatch=2,
                         world=(('colony', True), ('r', 2), ('squads', 4), ('warmAnswers', warm)))
        T.trainingReturns = noisy(1)
        trainRL19(c19)
        trainRL19(RL19Config(**{**c19.__dict__, 'steps': 2}))           # resumes from step 1 and its records; then the answer halt
        m = [json.loads(x) for x in open(f'{d}/c/metrics.jsonl')]
        assert [x['step'] for x in m] == [1, 2] and all(x['answerRatio'] < 1 / 3 and x['answerRef'] == 30.0 * 4 for x in m)
        assert json.load(open(f'{d}/c/halted.json'))['reason'].startswith('answers per board below a third')
        assert json.load(open(f'{d}/c/config.json'))['hash'] == configHash19(c19)
        rec = json.loads(open(f'{d}/c/records/step-0002.json').read())
        from collections import Counter
        from explRL.rl19_step import threatDraws
        seen = Counter((round(n * 8 / 16), j) for s in (0, 1) for j, (n, L) in enumerate(threatDraws(c19, s)))
        assert sorted((tuple(k), len(v['boards'])) for k, v in rec) == sorted(((8, nl, j, c), n) for (nl, j), n in seen.items() for c in range(2))
        # records follow (N, liar count, board, copy): a sequence's liar slots never change; 2 boards x 2 copies over the two steps
        recs = [json.loads(x) for x in open(f'{d}/c/turns/step-0001.jsonl')]
        assert recs and all(r['N'] == 8 and r['agent'] >= r['nLiar'] for r in recs)    # liar slots are scripted: never trained
        try:
            trainRL19(RL19Config(tiny, f'{d}/e', **kw, haltAnswers=3))
            raise AssertionError('an answer halt without warmAnswers ran')
        except ValueError:
            pass
    T.trainingReturns = _tr

import json, re
import numpy as np
from explRL.llm_agent import *
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient
from explRL.llm_env import TextForagingEnv, locationNames
from explRL.llm_board import TextBoardEnv
from explRL.board_agents import BoardLead, ClaimBoard
from explRL.harness import Blackboard, Lead, MessageBus
from explRL.harness_runs import benchWorld
from explRL.multi import spawnRngs
from explRL.taskboard import TaskBoardEnv

def obsOf(req):
    return req['messages'][0]['content'][-1]['text']

def forager(req):
    "Stay where you are and report it; every third turn go to the coordinator's suggestion or the first board entry."
    o = obsOf(req)
    here = re.search(r'You are at (\w+)', o).group(1)
    sug = re.search(r'suggests: (\w+)', o) or re.search(r'Board[^:]*: (\w+) ', o)
    go = sug and int(float(re.search(r'Time ([\d.]+)', o).group(1))) % 3 == 0 and sug.group(1) != 'empty'
    return json.dumps(dict(action='go' if go else 'stay', target=sug.group(1) if go else '', reportLocation=here,
                           reportValue=0.5, notes=f'at {here}'))

def team(channel, n=3, turns=6, memory='full', seed=0):
    w = benchWorld(); w.reset(seed, n)
    env = TextForagingEnv(w, locationNames(64, seed))
    fc = FakeClient(forager)
    ms = [LLMMember(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=fc), env, channel, memory=memory) for _ in range(n)]
    hist = runTurns(ms, w, turns)
    return ms, hist, fc, w

# every agent makes exactly its turn budget; extras record validity and reports
ms, hist, fc, w = team(None, turns=5)
assert [len(hist.forAgent(i)) for i in range(3)] == [5, 5, 5] and len(fc.requests) == 15
assert all(r.extras[0] and r.extras[4] for r in hist.records)
w = benchWorld(); w.reset(0, 3); env = TextForagingEnv(w, locationNames(64, 0))
h = runTurns([LLMMember(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(forager)), env) for _ in range(3)], w, [2, 4, 1])
assert [len(h.forAgent(i)) for i in range(3)] == [2, 4, 1]

# the same script gives identical logs
a, b = team(Blackboard(64, None, 0.01, 3))[0], team(Blackboard(64, None, 0.01, 3))[0]
assert json.dumps([m.log for m in a]) == json.dumps([m.log for m in b])

# channels: reports reach the blackboard, messages reach two teammates, the lead's suggestion reaches every agent
bb = Blackboard(64, None, 0.01, 3)
ms, *_ = team(bb)
assert sum(bb.stats[i]['written'] for i in range(3)) == 18
assert any('Board (' in r['obs'] and 'empty' not in r['obs'] for r in ms[1].log)
mb = MessageBus(3, 2, 10.0, np.inf, spawnRngs(5, 3))
ms, *_ = team(mb, turns=12)
assert sum(mb.stats[i]['sent'] for i in range(3)) > 0 and any('agent ' in r['obs'] for m in ms for r in m.log)
lead = Lead(64, 3)
ms, *_ = team(lead)
assert all('The coordinator suggests' in r['obs'] for m in ms for r in m.log) and lead.table.C.sum() > 0

# memory: full is append-only (each turn's history starts with the previous turn's), last8 keeps 8, notes keeps notes
ms, hist, fc, w = team(None, n=1, turns=12)
hs = [[c['text'] for c in r['messages'][0]['content'][:-1]] for r in fc.requests]
assert all(hs[k + 1][:len(hs[k])] == hs[k] and len(hs[k + 1]) == len(hs[k]) + 1 for k in range(11))
assert all('cache_control' in r['messages'][0]['content'][-2] for r in fc.requests[1:])
assert len({json.dumps(r['system']) for r in fc.requests}) == 1                        # the cached prefix never changes
ms, hist, fc, w = team(None, n=1, turns=12, memory='last8')
assert [len(r['messages'][0]['content']) - 1 for r in fc.requests] == [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 8, 8, 8]
ms, hist, fc, w = team(None, n=1, turns=3, memory='notes')
assert [c['text'] for c in fc.requests[2]['messages'][0]['content'][:-1]] == [f'Your notes so far: {ms[0].log[1]["response"] and json.loads(ms[0].log[1]["response"])["notes"]}']

# invalid replies, refusals and max_tokens stops become 'stay' and are counted
w = benchWorld(); w.reset(0, 1); env = TextForagingEnv(w, locationNames(64, 0))
fc = FakeClient([dict(text='{"action": "go", "target": "Atlantis", "reportLocation": "", "reportValue": 0, "notes": ""}'),
                 dict(text='', stop='refusal', refusal='other'), dict(text='{"act', stop='max_tokens')])
m = LLMMember(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=fc), env)
h = runTurns([m], w, 3)
assert [r.kind for r in h.records] == ['stay'] * 3 and [r.extras[0] for r in h.records] == [False] * 3
assert [x['refusal'] for x in m.log] == [None, 'other', None] and [x['stop'] for x in m.log][2] == 'max_tokens'

# framing and lessons change only the system prompt
w = benchWorld(); w.reset(0, 1); env = TextForagingEnv(w, locationNames(64, 0))
s = {f: LLMMember(None, env, framing=f).system() for f in FRAMING}
assert len(set(s.values())) == 3 and all(x.startswith(env.rules()) for x in s.values())
assert 'team\'s total food' in s['team'] and 'Lessons' in LLMMember(None, env, lessons='go east').system()
hs = LLMMember(None, env, home={3, 4}).system()
assert 'stay and work only there' in LLMMember(None, env, home={3, 4}, strict=True).system() and 'prefer working there' in hs
assert f"home range is the locations {env.names[3]}, {env.names[4]}" in hs and 'home range' not in s['own']

# beliefs: named estimates map to locations; unknown names and non-numbers are dropped
names = env.names
fc = FakeClient([json.dumps(dict(estimates=[dict(location=names[3], value=0.8), dict(location='Nowhere', value=1),
                                            dict(location=names[5], value=-2.6)]))])
m = LLMMember(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=fc), env); m.id = 0
e = elicitBeliefs(m)
assert e['n'][3] == e['n'][5] == 1 and sum(e['n']) == 2 and e['mean'][3] == 0.8 and e['mean'][5] == -2.6
assert m.log[-1]['kind'] == 'beliefs' and fc.requests[0]['output_config']['format']['schema'] == BELIEF_SCHEMA

# the board: a fake-client solver opens, then submits the right answer (read from the observation's puzzle)
def solver(req):
    o = obsOf(req)
    m = re.search(r'Your open subtask: T(\d+), open', o)
    if m:
        f, rng, y = re.search(r'return (.*)\n', o).group(1), int(re.search(r'x < (\d+)', o).group(1)), \
            int(re.search(r'f\(x\) == (-?\d+)', o).group(1))
        x = next(x for x in range(rng) if eval(f, {'x': x}) == y)
        return json.dumps(dict(action='submit', target='', answer=x, claimTask=f'T{m.group(1)}', claimKind='solved', notes=''))
    first = re.search(r'Open subtasks[^:]*: T(\d+)', o).group(1)
    return json.dumps(dict(action='open', target=f'T{first}', answer=0, claimTask=f'T{first}', claimKind='working', notes=''))
b = TaskBoardEnv(0, 2, difficulty=1); cb = ClaimBoard()
env = TextBoardEnv(b)
ms = [LLMMember(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(solver)), env, cb) for _ in range(2)]
h = runTurns(ms, b, 6)
assert b.counts['solved'] >= 3 and b.counts['wrong'] == 0 and all(r.extras[0] for r in h.records)
assert any('Claims: T' in r['obs'] for r in ms[1].log)

# scripted liars: the Phase 9 liar for foraging; the board liar posts claims on tasks it is not working on
assert isinstance(ScriptedLiarText('forage', None, None), Liar)
b = TaskBoardEnv(1, 2, difficulty=1); cb = ClaimBoard()
liar = ScriptedLiarText('board', cb, np.random.default_rng(0))
runTurns([liar], b, 6)
assert cb.stats[0]['written'] == 6 and all(k != b.opened[0] for k, *_ in cb.view(1, 6.0, b.open) if _[0] == 'working')

import json
from explRL.fix_grid import *
from explRL.bench_grid import rowKey
from explRL.clue_grid import BOARD, CLUE_SETTINGS, clueLiarGrid, clueMainGrid
from explRL.coop_grid import coopHash
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig, cellRow

key = lambda c: rowKey(cellRow(c, LLMConfig.fromDict(c['cfg']), dict(episode=0)))
g = fixGrid()
lv = lambda c: c['level']
a1 = [c for c in g if lv(c) in ('baseline', 'request', 'table', 'evidence')]
a2 = [c for c in g if lv(c) in ('record', 'verify', 'warn') or lv(c).endswith('|liar')]
# sizes: A1 4 arms x N {4, 8} x 10 seeds; A2 the other 3 arms clean and all 4 with the liar at N 4 (the baseline's clean
# N 4 cells are A1's), every cell 40 turns on the blackboard with Haiku and the Phase 11 board
assert len(g) == len(a1) + len(a2) == 80 + 70 and len({key(c) for c in g}) == len(g)
assert {c['seed'] for c in g} == set(range(900, 910)) and all(c['study'] == c['factor'] == 'fixA' for c in g)
for c in g:
    cfg, w = c['cfg'], c['cfg']['world']
    assert (cfg['channel'], cfg['turns'], cfg['model'], cfg['effort'], cfg['maxTokens']) == ('blackboard', 40, HAIKU, 'low', 8000)
    assert {k: w[k] for k in BOARD} == {k: CLUE_SETTINGS[k] for k in BOARD}
    assert {k: v for k, v in w.items() if k not in BOARD} == FIX_ARMS[lv(c).split('|')[0]]
    assert cfg['nLiar'] == lv(c).endswith('|liar') and (cfg['nLiar'] == 0 or c['N'] == 4)
assert FIX_ARMS['request'] == dict(ask=True) and FIX_ARMS['verify'] == dict(check=True) and FIX_ARMS['warn'] == dict(hint='warn')
# call counts and costs (design section 3): A1 about 17 000 new calls, A2 about 10 000
e1, e2 = fixEstimate(a1), fixEstimate(a2)
assert e1['calls'] == 19200 and e1['newCalls'] == 16800 and e2['calls'] == 9600 and e2['newCalls'] == 9600 - 360
assert 3.5 < e1['newCost'] < 4.5 and 1.8 < e2['newCost'] < 2.6

# The baseline cells are Phase 11's: everything that determines the API requests is equal (only study, factor and
# level differ), so the cached replies of seeds 900-904 (liar: 900-902) are reused
p11 = {(c['N'], c['seed'], c['cfg']['nLiar']): c for c in phase11Cells()}
base = [c for c in g if lv(c) in ('baseline', 'baseline|liar')]
same = [c for c in base if (c['N'], c['seed'], c['cfg']['nLiar']) in p11]
assert len(same) == 2 * 5 + 3 and all(c['seed'] <= 904 for c in same)
for c in same:
    ref = p11[(c['N'], c['seed'], c['cfg']['nLiar'])]
    assert c['cfg'] == ref['cfg'] and requestKey(c) == requestKey(ref) and (ref['study'], ref['level']) in (('clue', 'clue'), ('clueLiar', 'liar'))
    assert {k: v for k, v in c.items() if k not in ('study', 'factor', 'level')} == {k: v for k, v in ref.items() if k not in ('study', 'factor', 'level')}
assert {requestKey(c) for c in g if lv(c) not in ('baseline', 'baseline|liar')}.isdisjoint(map(requestKey, phase11Cells()))
# ... and they send the same requests (fake client, a few turns, clean and with the liar)
from explRL.clue_runs import runClue
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply
def requests(c):
    cl = LLMClient(HAIKU, 'low', 8000, client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
    runClue(LLMConfig.fromDict(dict(c['cfg'], turns=3)), c['seed'], cl)
    return cl.client.requests
for c in (same[0], [c for c in same if c['cfg']['nLiar']][0]):
    ref = p11[(c['N'], c['seed'], c['cfg']['nLiar'])]
    assert requests(c) == requests(ref) and len(requests(c)) == 3 * (c['N'] - c['cfg']['nLiar'])
# the new arms do change the requests (schema with 'ask' / 'check', rules, observations)
assert requests(fixCell('x', 'request', 4, 900)) != requests(same[0])

# pilot: each new arm at N 4, seeds 900-901, A2 arms with the liar; the main grid replays its cells
p = fixPilotGrid()
assert sorted({lv(c) for c in p}) == sorted(['request', 'table', 'evidence', 'record|liar', 'verify|liar', 'warn|liar'])
assert len(p) == 12 and {c['seed'] for c in p} == {900, 901} and {c['N'] for c in p} == {4}
assert {requestKey(c) for c in p} <= {requestKey(c) for c in g} and all(c['study'] == 'fixPilot' for c in p)

# the vote: 4 arms x 2 variants x 100 episodes plus the solo ceiling, episode seeds shared by every arm
v = profileGrid()
assert len(v) == (4 + 1) * 2 * 100 and {c['level'] for c in v} == {f'{a}|{x}' for a in (*A3, 'solo') for x in VARIANTS}
for lev in {c['level'] for c in v}:
    assert sorted(c['seed'] for c in v if c['level'] == lev) == list(range(5000, 5100))
w = v[0]['cfg']['world']
assert (w['shared'], w['unique'], v[0]['cfg']['turns'], v[0]['cfg']['N']) == ([1, 1, 3], 2, 3, 4) and all(c['study'] == 'profileA' for c in v)
ev = fixEstimate(v)
assert ev['calls'] == 4 * 2 * 100 * 16 + 2 * 100 == 13000 and ev['newCalls'] == 13000 and 2 < ev['cost'] < 4
pp = profilePilotGrid()
assert len(pp) == 3 * 20 and {c['level'] for c in pp} == {'baseline|classic', 'factsFirst|classic', 'solo|classic'}
assert {c['seed'] for c in pp} == set(range(5000, 5020)) and {requestKey(c) for c in pp} <= {requestKey(c) for c in v}
# pilots: about 3 000 calls in all, under $1
ep = [fixEstimate(p), fixEstimate(pp)]
assert sum(x['calls'] for x in ep) == 1680 + 660 and sum(x['cost'] for x in ep) < 1
# a plan change (the pilot's fact counts) reaches the grid
alt = dict(FIX_PLAN, profile=dict(FIX_PLAN['profile'], shared=[1, 1, 2], unique=3))
assert profilePilotGrid(alt)[0]['cfg']['world']['shared'] == [1, 1, 2] and profilePilotGrid(alt)[0]['cfg']['world']['unique'] == 3

# quick grids: every fix cell kind at two seeds and 6 turns; every vote level at four episodes
q, pq = fixQuick(), profileQuick()
assert len(q) == 30 and all(c['cfg']['turns'] == 6 for c in q) and {lv(c) for c in q} == {lv(c) for c in g}
assert len(pq) == 40 and {c['level'] for c in pq} == {c['level'] for c in v} and all(c['cfg']['turns'] == 40 for c in g)
# FIX_PLAN: version 1, not frozen yet, JSON-serialisable with a stable hash
assert FIX_PLAN['version'] == 1 and FIX_PLAN['frozen'] is True and coopHash(FIX_PLAN) == '79abfb531cdd'
# the HiddenBench replication's grids (AC-3b): 65 tasks x 3 reps x (4 arms + solo); seeds shared across arms; the pilot
hb, hp = hbGrid(), hbPilotGrid()
assert len(hb) == 65 * 3 * 5 and len(hp) == 40 and HB_PLAN['frozen'] is True and coopHash(HB_PLAN) == '791a2df079a8'
seeds = lambda arm: sorted(c['seed'] for c in hb if c['level'] == f'{arm}|hb')
assert all(seeds(a) == seeds('baseline') for a in HB_PLAN['arms']) and len(set(seeds('baseline'))) == 195
assert all(c['cfg']['world']['bench'] == 'hiddenbench' and c['cfg']['world']['item'] == c['seed'] // 1000 for c in hb)
assert {c['level'] for c in hp} == {'baseline|hb', 'solo|hb'} and {c['seed'] // 1000 for c in hp} == set(range(1, 21))
assert coopHash(json.loads(json.dumps(FIX_PLAN))) == coopHash(FIX_PLAN)
assert FIX_PLAN['holm']['A1'] == [['request', 4], ['request', 8], ['table', 4], ['table', 8]] and FIX_PLAN['holm']['A2'] == ['record', 'verify']
assert set(FIX_PLAN['analyses']) == {'A1', 'A1control', 'A2', 'A2control', 'A3', 'A3control', 'mechanism'}
# Phase 14: two more arms (FIX_PLAN keeps Phase 13's arms and hash); fixCell takes a number of liars
assert FIX_ARMS['recordPrivate'] == dict(record='private') and FIX_ARMS['verifyPublic'] == dict(check='public')
assert KIND['recordPrivate'] == KIND['verifyPublic'] == 'affordance' and len(FIX_ARMS) == 9
assert 'recordPrivate' not in FIX_PLAN['arms']['world'] and 'verifyPublic' not in FIX_PLAN['arms']['kind']
c2 = fixCell('x', 'record', 8, 900, 2)
assert c2['cfg']['nLiar'] == 2 and c2['level'] == 'record|liar' and fixCell('x', 'record', 4, 900, True) == fixCell('x', 'record', 4, 900, 1)

import copy
from types import SimpleNamespace
from explRL.clue_policy import claudePolicy
from explRL.clue_roll import rollout
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig

# AC-5 (Phase 12): group advantages on hand-made returns (seeds x group x N); equal returns give 0
R = np.array([[[1.0, 0.0], [3.0, 0.0]], [[2.0, 5.0], [2.0, 1.0]]])
A = groupAdvantages(R)
assert np.allclose(A[0, :, 0], [-1, 1], atol=1e-5) and np.all(A[0, :, 1] == 0) and np.all(A[1, :, 0] == 0)
assert np.allclose(A[1, :, 1], [1, -1], atol=1e-5)
# the format penalty lowers training returns only, per invalid reply of the slot
ro = SimpleNamespace(returns=np.array([[1.0, 2.0]]), logs=[[[dict(valid=True), dict(valid=False)], [dict(valid=False)] * 3]])
assert np.allclose(trainingReturns(ro, 0.1), [[0.9, 1.7]]) and np.allclose(ro.returns, [[1.0, 2.0]])

# hand-made boards (AC-4): turn records (time, delivered reward, valid), the board's submit log and the credit pending at the end
rec = lambda t, r, valid=True: dict(t=t, reward=r, valid=valid)
bd = lambda pending, submits=(): SimpleNamespace(pending=np.array(pending, float), submits=list(submits))
def ro2(logs, boards, seeds):
    ret = [[sum(x['reward'] for x in recs) + b.pending[i] for i, recs in enumerate(lg)] for lg, b in zip(logs, boards)]
    return SimpleNamespace(logs=logs, boards=boards, seeds=seeds, returns=np.array(ret))
# wrong answers cost wrongPenalty in training returns only (from the submit log: slot 0 twice, slot 1 once; 'late' is free)
subs = [(0.0, 0, 3, 2, 'wrong'), (2.0, 0, 3, 1, 'wrong'), (1.0, 1, 4, None, 'wrong'), (3.0, 1, 4, 1, 'late')]
r = ro2([[[rec(0.0, -0.5), rec(2.0, -0.5, False)], [rec(1.0, -0.5), rec(3.0, 0.0)]]], [bd([0, 0], subs)], [7])
logs0 = copy.deepcopy(r.logs)
assert np.allclose(trainingReturns(r, 0.1, 2.5), [[-1 - 0.1 - 5, -0.5 - 2.5]]) and np.allclose(trainingReturns(r, 0.1), [[-1.1, -0.5]])
assert np.array_equal(trainingReturns(r, 0.1, 0.0), trainingReturns(r, 0.1)) and r.logs == logs0      # turn logs untouched
# per-turn rewards: the wrong answer at its own turn (matched by time), the format penalty at the invalid turn
assert np.allclose(turnRewards(r, 0.1, 2.5)[0][0], [-3.0, -3.1]) and np.allclose(turnRewards(r, 0.1, 2.5)[0][1], [-3.0, 0.0])
assert turnRewards(r, 0.1)[0][1] == [-0.5, 0.0]
# equal groups -> 0 at every turn
same = ro2([[[rec(0, 1.0), rec(1, 0.0)]]] * 3, [bd([0.5])] * 3, [5, 5, 5])
assert turnAdvantages(same, 0.1, 2.5) == [[[0.0, 0.0]]] * 3
# a late credit counts toward the sharing turn's reward-to-go: board 0's slot 0 shares at turn 0 (reward 0) and is credited
# at turn 2 (delivered) or only at the end (pending); the replays where nothing is credited get the opposite advantage
for logs, pend in (([rec(0, 0.0), rec(1, 0.0), rec(2, 1.5)], 0.0), ([rec(0, 0.0), rec(1, 0.0), rec(2, 0.0)], 1.5)):
    t = ro2([[logs], [[rec(0, 0.0), rec(1, 0.0), rec(2, 0.0)]]], [bd([pend]), bd([0.0])], [9, 9])
    G, a = rewardsToGo(t, 0.1), turnAdvantages(t, 0.1)
    assert np.allclose(G[0][0], [1.5, 1.5, 1.5]) and np.allclose(a[0][0], [1, 1, 1], atol=1e-5) and np.allclose(a[1][0], [-1, -1, -1], atol=1e-5)
# per turn, not per board: the same total, earned at different turns, differs only at the turn in between
t = ro2([[[rec(0, 0.0), rec(1, 2.0), rec(2, 0.0)]], [[rec(0, 0.0), rec(1, 0.0), rec(2, 2.0)]]], [bd([0.0])] * 2, [3, 3])
a = turnAdvantages(t, 0.1)
assert a[0][0][:2] == [0.0, 0.0] and np.allclose([a[0][0][2], a[1][0][2]], [-1, 1], atol=1e-5)
assert np.all(groupAdvantages(trainingReturns(t, 0.1).reshape(1, 2, 1)) == 0)     # the board-level advantage sees no difference
# groups are the boards of one seed, whatever their order
t = ro2([[[rec(0, 1.0)]], [[rec(0, 0.0)]], [[rec(0, 3.0)]], [[rec(0, 2.0)]]], [bd([0.0])] * 4, [1, 2, 1, 2])
assert np.allclose([x[0][0] for x in turnAdvantages(t, 0.1)], [-1, -1, 1, 1], atol=1e-5)

# samples: one per text turn of slots with nonzero advantage, with its prompt; zero-advantage slots skipped
cfg = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=3, world=dict(m=2, r=1, R=30))
ro = rollout(cfg, [900, 900], claudePolicy(LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply))), keepPrompts=True)
adv = np.zeros((2, 4)); adv[0, 1], adv[1, 3] = 0.5, -1.0
smp = stepSamples(ro, adv)
assert len(smp) == 6 and {x['slot'] for x in smp} == {1, 3} and all(x['blocks'][-1]['text'].startswith('Now:\n') for x in smp)
assert [x['adv'] for x in smp] == [0.5] * 3 + [-1.0] * 3 and all(x['eos'] for x in smp)
# a share of the turns: a seeded, sorted subset of the full set, of the requested size
full = stepSamples(ro, adv)
part = stepSamples(ro, adv, 0.5, np.random.default_rng([0, 7]))
assert len(part) == 3 and all(x in full for x in part) and part == stepSamples(ro, adv, 0.5, np.random.default_rng([0, 7]))
assert stepSamples(ro, adv * 0, 0.25) == [] and len(stepSamples(ro, adv, 0.01)) == 1
# per-turn advantages: a constant list per slot gives the per-slot samples; zero turns are skipped
perTurn = [[[float(adv[b, i])] * len(ro.logs[b][i]) for i in range(4)] for b in range(2)]
assert stepSamples(ro, perTurn) == full and stepSamples(ro, perTurn, 0.5, np.random.default_rng([0, 7])) == part
perTurn[0][1][1] = 0.0
assert [x['adv'] for x in stepSamples(ro, perTurn)] == [0.5, 0.5] + [-1.0] * 3
# on a real rollout: G at the first turn is the training return; the board's wrong answers are the turn logs' wrong submits
rt = trainingReturns(ro, 0.1, 2.5)
assert all(np.isclose(rewardsToGo(ro, 0.1, 2.5)[b][i][0], rt[b, i]) for b in range(2) for i in range(4))
assert sum(len(wrongTimes(b, i)) for b in ro.boards for i in range(4)) == sum(b.counts['wrong'] for b in ro.boards) > 0
ta = turnAdvantages(ro, 0.1, 2.5)
assert [len(x) for x in ta[0]] == [len(x) for x in ro.logs[0]] and all(v == 0 for b in ta for x in b for v in x)  # replays of one board, same replies

import json, tempfile, os

import math
import numpy as np
from explRL.cluetask import *

# AC-2: every feasible prime set gives a unique answer; any m - 1 clues leave at least two candidates
for m, R in CLUE_PAIRS:
    sets = primeSets(m, R)
    assert sets, (m, R)
    for ps in sets:
        for x in (0, R // 3, R - 1):
            t = ClueTask(ps, x, R)
            allc = {j: t.clue(j)[1] for j in range(m)}
            assert t.candidates(allc) == [x] and t.check(x) and not t.check(x + 1 if x + 1 < R else 0)
            for drop in range(m):
                part = {j: r for j, r in allc.items() if j != drop}
                assert len(t.candidates(part)) >= 2, (ps, x, drop)
assert [len(primeSets(m, R)) for m, R in CLUE_PAIRS] == [8, 4, 1, 4, 1] and not primeSets(2, 210)
a, b = makeClueTask(np.random.default_rng(3), 3, 210), makeClueTask(np.random.default_rng(3), 3, 210)
assert a == b and a.primes in primeSets(3, 210) and 0 <= a.x < 210
assert not ClueTask((3, 5, 7), 23, 105).check(True) and not ClueTask((3, 5, 7), 23, 105).check(23.0)

DN = 'multiagent/bench'

DEVIATIONS = 'none'


def gitCommit():
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        return out.stdout.strip() or 'unknown'
    except OSError:
        return 'unknown'


def jsonTable(tab):
    "Side-sweep table with string keys, for metrics.json."
    return {f: {l: {f'{c}/{n}': v for (c, n), v in cols.items()} for l, cols in lv.items()} for f, lv in tab.items()}


def save(mode, rows, figs, meta, extra, text):
    writeCSV(rows, demo_artifact_dir(mode, DN) / 'runs.csv')
    for name, f in figs.items():
        save_demo_figure(name, fig=f, mode=mode, demo_name=DN)
    plt.close('all')
    save_demo_metrics({**meta, **extra}, mode=mode, demo_name=DN)
    return save_demo_report(text, mode=mode, demo_name=DN)

import hashlib
import json

import numpy as np

from explRL.clueboard import ClueBoardEnv
from explRL.contest import *

# Hand-built boards: liar slot 0; G a contester, A another honest poster, W a watcher that lacks clue j of subtask k
kw = dict(m=2, r=1, R=30)
b0 = ClueBoardEnv(3, 6, **kw)
k, j = b0.open[0], 0
p, rt = b0.tasks[k].task.clue(j)
lie, x = (rt + 1) % p, b0.tasks[k].task.x
H0 = b0.tasks[k].holders[j]
W = next(a for a in range(1, 6) if a not in H0)
G, A, V = [a for a in range(1, 6) if a != W][:3]          # V: another agent, holding j or not


def play(events, scheme='contest', slots=(G,), H=4.0, N=6):
    b = ClueBoardEnv(3, N, scheme=scheme, contest=dict(liarSlots=[0], contestSlots=slots, halfLife=H), **kw)
    for t, i, a in events:
        b.apply(i, a, float(t))
    return b


share = lambda r: ('share', (k, j, r))
solve = lambda t: [(t, W, ('open', k)), (t + 1, W, ('submit', x))]
gain = lambda ev, a=G, **o: float(play(ev, **o).pending[a] - play(ev, 'credit', **o).pending[a])


# test_contest (AC-3): a contest at lag 0 and lag H pays 0.5 and 0.25 per qualifying solve, on top of credit's share
for L, want in ((0, 0.5), (4, 0.25), (2, 0.5 * 2 ** -0.5)):
    ev = [(0, 0, share(lie)), (0, W, ('wait', None)), (L, G, share(rt))] + solve(L + 1)
    assert abs(gain(ev) - want) < 1e-12, (L, gain(ev))
    b = play(ev)
    c, = b.contestLog.contests
    assert (c.t_c, c.who, c.k, c.j, c.t_l, c.lie, c.liar) == (L, G, k, j, 0.0, lie, 0) and c.watchers == {W: L + 2.0}
    assert b.contestLog.paid == [(L + 2.0, G, W, k, j, want)] and b.contestLog.earned(6)[G] == want
    assert G in b._creditTo(W, k) and play(ev, 'credit').pending[G] > 0      # the credit share is credit's own rule
assert abs(gain([(0, 0, share(lie)), (0, W, ('wait', None)), (3, G, share(rt))] + solve(4), H=2.0) - 0.5 * 2 ** -1.5) < 1e-12
# a contest against an honest false value pays nothing (and is no contest), even when a liar repeats that value
ev = [(0, A, share(lie)), (0, W, ('wait', None)), (1, 0, share(lie)), (2, G, share(rt))] + solve(3)
assert gain(ev) == 0 and play(ev).contestLog.contests == []
# a non-contest slot (contestSlots 'guards' and G no guard) is paid nothing, though its contest is recorded
ev = [(0, 0, share(lie)), (0, W, ('wait', None)), (1, G, share(rt))] + solve(2)
assert gain(ev, slots=()) == 0 and len(play(ev, slots=()).contestLog.contests) == 1 and play(ev, slots=()).contestLog.paid == []
# an agent that holds the clue does not qualify
h = next(iter(H0)) if 0 not in H0 else None
if h is not None and h != G:
    ev = [(0, 0, share(lie)), (0, h, ('wait', None)), (1, G, share(rt)), (2, h, ('open', k)), (3, h, ('submit', x))]
    assert gain(ev) == 0 and play(ev).contestLog.contests[0].watchers == {}
bh = play([(0, 0, share(lie))], N=6)
holder = next(iter(bh.tasks[k].holders[j]))
bh.contestLog.onShown(1.0, holder, bh.contestLog.shownOn(bh.open))
assert (k, j) not in bh.contestLog.sawLie or holder not in bh.contestLog.sawLie[(k, j)]
# the contester is never its own watcher; a liar's true post is no contest; a solve pays once per (contest, watcher)
ev = [(0, 0, share(lie)), (0, G, ('wait', None)), (1, G, share(rt)), (2, G, ('open', k)), (3, G, ('submit', x))]
assert play(ev).contestLog.contests[0].watchers == {} and play(ev).contestLog.paid == []
assert play([(0, 0, share(lie)), (0, W, ('wait', None)), (1, 0, share(rt))]).contestLog.contests == []
b = play([(0, 0, share(lie)), (0, W, ('wait', None)), (1, G, share(rt))] + solve(2))
assert b.contestLog.onSolve(5.0, W, k) == [] and len(b.contestLog.paid) == 1
# two contests of one lie: each pays its own decayed bonus for a watcher shown the lie before it
ev = [(0, 0, share(lie)), (0, W, ('wait', None)), (1, G, share(rt)), (2, A, share(rt))] + solve(3)
b = play(ev, slots=(G, A))
assert [(c.who, c.watchers) for c in b.contestLog.contests] == [(G, {W: 4.0}), (A, {W: 4.0})]
assert abs(gain(ev, slots=(G, A)) - 0.5 * 2 ** -0.25) < 1e-12 and abs(gain(ev, A, slots=(G, A)) - 0.5 * 2 ** -0.5) < 1e-12
assert abs(preventionBonus(4, 4) - 0.25) < 1e-15 and preventionBonus(0, 4) == 0.5
# a watcher's solve at the contest's own time does not pay (t > t_c, design-low-level); one turn later it does
b = play([(0, 0, share(lie)), (0, W, ('wait', None)), (1, G, share(rt))])
assert b.contestLog.onSolve(1.0, W, k) == [] and b.contestLog.contests[0].watchers == {W: None}
assert b.contestLog.onSolve(1.5, W, k) == [(G, 0.5 * 2 ** -0.25)]


# test_watchers (AC-3b): a watcher shown a true value before the lie does not qualify (nor one shown both at once)
ev = [(0, A, share(rt)), (1, W, ('wait', None)), (2, 0, share(lie)), (3, W, ('wait', None)), (3, V, ('wait', None)),
      (4, G, share(rt))] + solve(5)
b = play(ev)
assert len(b.contestLog.contests) == 1 and b.contestLog.contests[0].watchers == {} and gain(ev) == 0
# a contest that is not the first true post earns the bonus but not the credit share (the first true poster keeps it)
ev = [(0, 0, share(lie)), (0, W, ('wait', None)), (1, A, share(rt)), (2, G, share(rt))] + solve(3)
bc, bk = play(ev), play(ev, 'credit')
assert bk.pending[G] == 0 and abs(bc.pending[G] - 0.5 * 2 ** -0.5) < 1e-12
assert bc.pending[A] == bk.pending[A] > 0 and bk._creditTo(W, k) == [A]
assert [c.who for c in bc.contestLog.contests] == [A, G] and [x[1] for x in bc.contestLog.paid] == [G]


# test_credit_equal (AC-2): scheme 'credit' (and 'team', 'individual') rewards equal the code before Phase 19, on rule-agent
# games (boards with and without colony options, guards, squads) and on rollouts with fake replies; digests recorded at d65634c
from explRL.clue_policy import claudePolicy
from explRL.clue_roll import rollout
from explRL.clue_runs import clueSetup
from explRL.colony_agents import faultClass, memberClass, scriptedFaults
from explRL.colony_board import stage4Members
from explRL.llm_agent import runTurns
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig
from explRL.multi import spawnRngs

digest = lambda out: hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
GAMES = ((4, 0, {}), (8, 2, dict(r=2, colony=True)), (8, 2, dict(r=2, colony=True, guards=2)),
         (16, 4, dict(r=2, colony=True, guards=4, squads=4)))


def ruleGame(sch, N, nl, w, seed, slots=None):
    cfg = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=N, turns=30, nLiar=nl, world=w)
    b, ch = clueSetup(cfg, seed)
    b.scheme = sch
    if slots is not None:
        b.contestLog = ContestLog(b, range(nl), slots)
    rngs = spawnRngs(seed + 1000, N)
    runTurns(stage4Members(w, [faultClass(w)(ch, rngs[i]) if i < nl else memberClass(w, i, nl)(ch, rngs[i]) for i in range(N)]), b, 30)
    return b


out = []
for sch in ('credit', 'team', 'individual'):
    for N, nl, w in GAMES:
        for seed in (900, 901):
            b = ruleGame(sch, N, nl, w, seed)
            out.append((sch, N, nl, seed, [round(r[7], 12) for r in b.ledger], np.round(b.pending, 12).tolist(), b.counts))
assert digest(out) == '64676b4bf4fb098b', digest(out)
fake = lambda: LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
out = []
for sch in ('credit', 'team', 'individual'):
    for N, nl, w in ((4, 0, dict(m=2, R=30)), (4, 1, dict(m=2, R=30)), (8, 2, dict(r=2, colony=True)), (8, 2, dict(r=2, colony=True, guards=2))):
        cfg = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=N, turns=10, nLiar=nl, world=dict(w, scheme=sch))
        ro = rollout(cfg, [900, 901], claudePolicy(fake()), scriptedFaults(cfg.world, nl))
        out.append((sch, N, nl, [[[x['reward'] for x in lg] for lg in lgs] for lgs in ro.logs], np.round(ro.returns, 12).tolist(),
                    [bd.counts for bd in ro.boards]))
assert digest(out) == 'b75e5d2a6fdbff55', digest(out)
# 'contest' with no contest slot is 'credit' exactly; with every honest slot, rewards differ by exactly the bonuses paid
for N, nl, w in GAMES[1:]:
    for seed in (900, 901):
        cr, none, every = ruleGame('credit', N, nl, w, seed), ruleGame('contest', N, nl, w, seed, ()), ruleGame('contest', N, nl, w, seed, range(nl, N))
        assert [r[7] for r in none.ledger] == [r[7] for r in cr.ledger] and (none.pending == cr.pending).all()
        tot = lambda b: np.bincount([r[0] for r in b.ledger], [r[7] for r in b.ledger], N) + b.pending
        assert np.allclose(tot(every) - tot(cr), every.contestLog.earned(N)) and every.counts == cr.counts
        assert all(nl <= a < N for _, a, *_ in every.contestLog.paid)
assert sum(len(ruleGame('contest', 16, 4, GAMES[3][2], s, range(4, 16)).contestLog.paid) for s in (900, 901)) > 0


# test_penalty (AC-4, penalty part): the penalty fires exactly when answers fall below a third of the reference, on every
# honest slot; the table may be a dict or (key, value) pairs (JSON lists); a board type missing from it fails
T = {(4, 1, 30): 9.0}
assert sharePenalty(2, (4, 1, 30), T, 0.5) == 0.5 and sharePenalty(3, (4, 1, 30), T, 0.5) == 0.0
assert sharePenalty(2, [4, 1, 30.0], [([4, 1, 30], 9)], 0.5) == 0.5 and boardType(4, 1, 30.0) == (4, 1, 30)
try:
    sharePenalty(0, (8, 2, 30), T, 0.5)
    raise AssertionError('missing board type')
except KeyError:
    pass
b = ClueBoardEnv(3, 4, **kw)
x4 = b.tasks[k].task.x
b.apply(2, ('open', k), 0.0)
b.apply(2, ('submit', (x4 + 1) % 30), 1.0)                # one honest answer (wrong); slot 0's answer does not count
b.apply(0, ('open', k), 1.0)
b.apply(0, ('submit', x4), 2.0)
assert honestAnswers(b, 1) == 1
before = b.pending.copy()
assert applySharePenalty(b, 1, {(4, 1, 30): 3.0}, 0.5) == 0.0 and (b.pending == before).all()    # 1 == 3 / 3: not below
assert applySharePenalty(b, 1, {(4, 1, 30): 3.5}, 0.5) == 0.5 and (b.pending - before).tolist() == [0, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5]
# through rollout: world sharePenalty and warmAnswers take it from every honest slot's return, and from its last reward-to-go
cfg = lambda **o: LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=6, nLiar=1, world=dict(m=2, R=30, scheme='credit', **o))
ref = rollout(cfg(), [900], claudePolicy(fake()), scriptedFaults({}, 1))
pen = rollout(cfg(sharePenalty=0.5, warmAnswers={(4, 1, 30): 1e6}), [900], claudePolicy(fake()), scriptedFaults({}, 1))
off = rollout(cfg(sharePenalty=0.5, warmAnswers={(4, 1, 30): 0.0}), [900], claudePolicy(fake()), scriptedFaults({}, 1))
assert np.allclose(pen.returns - ref.returns, [[0, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5]]) and (off.returns == ref.returns).all()
assert (pen.boards[0].pending - ref.boards[0].pending).tolist() == [0, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5]


# test_records (AC-4b): an agent's record lists only its own payoffs, and resets between sequences of 6 boards
r = Records(3)
assert r.line(1) == 'Your record: this is the first board of a sequence of 6.'
for n in range(5):
    r.add(1, 'answers', 1.25 + n)
    r.add(2, 'contests', 7.5)
    r.endBoard()
assert '1.25' in r.line(1) and '7.50' not in r.line(1) and '7.50' in r.line(2) and '1.25' not in r.line(2)
assert r.line(1).count('board ') == 5 and 'board 5: your answers earned 5.25, your contests earned 0.00' in r.line(1)
r.endBoard()                                               # the sixth board ends the sequence
assert r.boards == [] and r.line(1).startswith('Your record: this is the first')
# through rollout: the honest prompts end with the agent's own line, and each board's payoffs are added to its record
c = LLMConfig(task='clue', channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=4, nLiar=1, world=dict(m=2, R=30, colony=True, guards=1, scheme='contest', contestSlots='all'))

assert list(contestOptions(dict(contestSlots='all', halfLife=2), 8, 2)['contestSlots']) == list(range(2, 8))

import hashlib
from explRL.bridge_grid import c1Grid
from explRL.colony3 import reusedCells, stage3Grid, stage3PilotGrid
from explRL.colony4 import stage4Grid
from explRL.colony_grid import stage1Grid
from explRL.fix_grid import fixGrid

def promptHash(cells):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    for c in cells:
        e = envOf(c)
        h.update(json.dumps([e.rules()] + [e.rules(i) for i in range(c['cfg']['N'])]).encode())
    return h.hexdigest()[:12]

for n, (cs, h) in G.items():
    assert promptHash(cs) == h, (n, promptHash(cs))

# test_couple (AC-2, FR-A1, P20-1): every fourth subtask per squad is coupled, clue 0 held in s and clue 1 in s + 1 (two
# holders each), never both clues to one agent; values and clues equal the `squads` board's on the same seed
from explRL.colony_board import squadOf
from explRL.colony_grid import WORLD18

kw, G = dict(WORLD18), range(16, 32)                       # 64 agents in squads of 8: liars 0-15, guards 16-31
for seed in (1800, 1801, 1890):
    a = ColonyBoardEnv(seed, 64, guardSlots=G, squads=8, **kw)
    b = BridgeBoardEnv(seed, 64, guardSlots=G, squads=8, nLiar=16, couple=0.25, bridges=1, **kw)
    for t in range(1, 61):                                  # replacements deal too
        a.advance(t), b.advance(t)
    assert a.serial == b.serial > 300 and a.squadOfTask == b.squadOfTask
    assert all(a.tasks[k].value == b.tasks[k].value and a.tasks[k].task == b.tasks[k].task for k in a.tasks)
    for s in range(8):
        ks = sorted(k for k in b.tasks if b.squadOfTask[k] == s)
        assert [k in b.coupled for k in ks] == [n % 4 == 3 for n in range(len(ks))] and b.nAssigned[s] == len(ks)
    first = min(b.coupled)                                  # the deal matches the squads board's up to the first coupled subtask
    assert all(a.tasks[k].holders == b.tasks[k].holders for k in range(first))
    for k, h in b.tasks.items():
        s = b.squadOfTask[k]
        assert not (h.holders[0] & h.holders[1]) and all(len(hs) == 2 for hs in h.holders)
        if k in b.coupled:
            assert b.coupled[k] == (s, (s + 1) % 8)
            assert {squadOf(x, 64, 8) for x in h.holders[0]} == {s} and {squadOf(x, 64, 8) for x in h.holders[1]} == {(s + 1) % 8}
        else:
            assert all(squadOf(x, 64, 8) == s for hs in h.holders for x in hs)
    assert abs(len(b.coupled) / len(b.tasks) - 0.25) < 0.02

# without coupling (couple 0, no bridges) the board is the squads board, deal included
z = BridgeBoardEnv(1800, 64, guardSlots=G, squads=8, nLiar=16, couple=0, **kw)
a = ColonyBoardEnv(1800, 64, guardSlots=G, squads=8, **kw)
assert all(z.tasks[k].holders == a.tasks[k].holders and z.tasks[k].task == a.tasks[k].task for k in a.tasks) and not z.coupled
# coupling with guardDeal keeps one guard copy per clue, in the clue's own squad
g = BridgeBoardEnv(3, 64, guardSlots=G, squads=8, guardDeal=True, nLiar=16, couple=0.25, **kw)
assert all(len(hs & set(G)) == 1 for k in g.coupled for hs in g.tasks[k].holders)


# test_mirror_isolation (AC-3, FR-A1, FR-A3, P20-16), the board's half: a mirror share goes to mirrorLog, never to shareLog
# or the channel, so squad s's tally, colonyLine and knownColony never show it; mirrorTally reads mirrorLog; squad s + 1
# cannot open or answer a mirror; only holders of the cross clue (and liar slots) of s + 1 see it, other squads never.
# Left for T2: the prompt (TextClueEnv.observe with bridgeLines), parse, and numpy posters (bridgeMembers, MirrorLiar).
from explRL.clue_agents import ClueBoard
from explRL.clue_colony import colonyLine, knownColony, tally
from explRL.colony_board import squadView

b = BridgeBoardEnv(1800, 64, guardSlots=G, squads=8, nLiar=16, couple=0.25, bridges=1, **kw)
k = next(k for k in b.open if k in b.coupled and max(b.tasks[k].holders[0]) >= 16)   # with an honest clue-0 holder
s, s2 = b.coupled[k]
task, (p1, r1) = b.tasks[k], b.tasks[k].task.clue(1)
h1, h2 = sorted(task.holders[1])                            # the cross clue's holders, in s2
o = next(x for x in task.holders[0] if x >= 16)             # an honest holder of clue 0, in s
non = next(x for x in range(32, 64) if x % 8 == s2 and x not in task.holders[1])   # honest, in s2, no cross clue
liar = next(x for x in range(16) if x % 8 == s2)
far = next(x for x in range(32, 64) if x % 8 not in (s, s2))
assert k in b.mirrors(h1) and k in b.mirrors(h2) and k in b.mirrors(liar)        # P20-5: liars of s2 draw from all mirrors
assert k not in b.mirrors(non) and k not in b.mirrors(o) and k not in b.mirrors(far) and k in b.mirrors(non, every=True)
v, vn, vf, vo = (squadView(b, x) for x in (h1, non, far, o))
assert isinstance(v, BridgeView) and k in v.mirrors() and v.crossClues()[k] == (p1, r1) and k not in v.open
assert k not in vn.mirrors() and k not in vf.mirrors() and k in vo.open and v.pair is None
assert all(x[0] != k for x in v.observe(h1)['open'])

ch = ClueBoard()                                            # the blackboard: what TextClueEnv.post writes, from shares only
def act(i, a, t):
    n = len(b.shareLog)
    out = b.apply(i, a, t)
    if len(b.shareLog) > n:
        x = b.shareLog[-1]
        ch.post(i, x[2], (x[3], b.tasks[x[2]].task.primes[x[3]], x[4]), t)
    return out

c0 = dict(b.counts)
for i in (h1, h2):
    rew, _, loc, info = act(i, ('share', (k, 1, r1)), 1)
    assert loc == k and info['result'] == 'shared' and b.ledger[-1][4] == k and b.ledger[-1][0] == i
act(liar, ('share', (k, 1, (r1 + 1) % p1)), 2)
act(o, ('share', (k, 0, task.task.clue(0)[1])), 2)          # an ordinary share by squad s
assert b.counts['shares'] == c0['shares'] + 4 and len(b.shareLog) == 1 and len(b.mirrorLog) == 3
assert [m[1] for m in b.mirrorLog] == [h1, h2, liar] and [m[6] for m in b.mirrorLog] == [False, False, True]
assert b.mirrorLog[1][5] and not b.mirrorLog[0][5]          # redundant flag, as shareLog's
assert b.mirrorTally(k) == {k: {1: [(r1, frozenset({h1, h2}), 1.0), ((r1 + 1) % p1, frozenset({liar}), 2.0)]}}
assert b.mirrorTally(next(x for x in b.open if x != k)) == {}
tal = tally(ch, vo)
assert set(tal[k]) == {0} and 1 not in knownColony(o, vo, ch)[k]
assert f'x mod {p1} =' not in colonyLine(vo, tal) and f'x mod {task.task.primes[0]} =' in colonyLine(vo, tal)
assert all(k not in tally(ch, squadView(b, x)) for x in (h1, liar, far))
# invalid: opening a mirror (so answering it), a mirror share without the cross clue, clue 0 on a mirror, a mirror of another squad
for i, a in ((h1, ('open', k)), (non, ('share', (k, 1, r1))), (h1, ('share', (k, 0, 0))), (far, ('share', (k, 1, r1)))):
    try:
        b.apply(i, a, 3)
        raise AssertionError(f'{i} {a} should raise')
    except ValueError:
        pass
assert b.opened[h1] != k and len(b.mirrorLog) == 3 and len(b.shareLog) == 1
# an expired mirror is gone from mirrors(i)
b.advance(b.tasks[k].expire)
assert k not in b.mirrors(h1)


# test_deal_bridges (AC-4, FR-A2, P20-2, AC-10's dealBridges part): one and two bridges per pair from the honest non-guard
# slots, guarding bridges from the guards, uneven liars (6 of 16 in squads of 4), clean boards, and the errors
assert dealBridges(64, 8, 16, 16) == [[32 + s] for s in range(8)]
assert dealBridges(64, 8, 16, 16, 2) == [[32 + s, 40 + s] for s in range(8)]
assert dealBridges(64, 8, 16, 16, 1, True) == [[16 + s] for s in range(8)]
assert dealBridges(64, 8, 16, 16, 0) == [[]] * 8
assert dealBridges(64, 8, 0, 16) == [[16 + s] for s in range(8)] and dealBridges(64, 8, 0, 16, 1, True) == [[s] for s in range(8)]
# 16 agents in squads of 4, 6 liars (2, 2, 1, 1) and 4 guards: squads 0 and 1 keep one honest non-guard slot
assert dealBridges(16, 4, 6, 4) == [[12], [13], [10], [11]] and dealBridges(16, 4, 6, 4, 1, True) == [[8], [9], [6], [7]]
assert dealBridges(16, 8, 4, 4) == [[8], [9]]
for args in ((16, 4, 6, 4, 2), (64, 8, 16, 16, 2, True), (64, 8, 16, 16, 3), (64, 8, 16, 0, 1, True), (64, 8, 16, 12),
             (16, 4, 8, 8, 1)):

for n, bg, want in ((1, False, [32 + s for s in range(8)]), (2, False, [32 + s for s in range(16)]), (1, True, list(G)[:8])):
    b = BridgeBoardEnv(1800, 64, guardSlots=G, squads=8, nLiar=16, couple=0.25, bridges=n, bridgeGuard=bg, **kw)
    assert sorted(b.bridgeSet) == want and all(b.bridgeOf(x) == (x % 8, (x + 1) % 8) for x in want)
    assert all(b.bridgeOf(x) is None for x in range(64) if x not in want) and (b.bridgeSet <= b.guardSet) == bg
# checkBridge (FR-B3's board checks)

assert checkBridge(w, 64, 16) and checkBridge(dict(w, bridgeGuard=True), 64, 16) and checkBridge({}, 64, 16)
for bad in (dict(w, squads=None), dict(w, couple=None), dict(w, bridges=2, bridgeGuard=True), dict(w, guards=0, bridgeGuard=True),

              lambda: BridgeBoardEnv(1, 64, guardSlots=range(16, 16 + bad['guards']), nLiar=16,

# test_relay_credit (AC-6, FR-A5, P20-12; the board's half of AC-4's relay): a bridge's share of a mirror value is a relay
# logged with its source; relaySource finds the liar for a relayed lie; under 'credit' and 'contest' a relayed clue's credit
# is split equally between the bridge and the first true poster on the mirror; under 'individual' the rewards equal
# ColonyBoardEnv's for the same moves
from explRL.contest import contestOptions

def play(scheme, cls=BridgeBoardEnv):
    "Seed 1800, 16 agents in squads of 4 (4 liars, 4 guards, one bridge per pair); the moves on the first coupled subtask."
    x = dict(scheme=scheme, contest=contestOptions(dict(guards=4, contestSlots='all'), 16, 4) if scheme == 'contest' else None)
    b = BridgeBoardEnv(1800, 16, guardSlots=range(4, 8), squads=4, nLiar=4, couple=0.25, bridges=1, **kw, **x)
    k = next(k for k in b.open if k in b.coupled)
    s, s2 = b.coupled[k]
    task, br = b.tasks[k], b.bridges[s][0]
    (p1, r1), r0 = task.task.clue(1), task.task.clue(0)[1]
    h, liar = next(i for i in sorted(task.holders[1]) if i >= 4), next(i for i in range(4) if i % 4 == s2)
    solver = next(i for i in sorted(task.holders[0]) if i != br)
    lie = (r1 + 1) % p1
    mirror = [(liar, ('share', (k, 1, lie))), (h, ('share', (k, 1, r1)))]
    moves = [(br, ('share', (k, 1, lie))), (br, ('share', (k, 1, r1))), (solver, ('open', k)), (solver, ('submit', task.task.x))]
    if cls is not BridgeBoardEnv:
        b = cls(1800, 16, guardSlots=range(4, 8), squads=4, **kw, **x)
        assert b.tasks[k].task == task.task and b.squadOfTask[k] == s and br % 4 == s
    seq = list(enumerate(mirror + moves, 1))[0 if cls is BridgeBoardEnv else len(mirror):]   # the same times on both boards
    rews = [b.apply(i, a, t)[0] for t, (i, a) in seq]
    return b, k, task.value, (br, h, liar, solver), rews[-len(moves):]

b, k, v, (br, h, liar, solver), rews = play('credit')
assert [x[1:5] for x in b.relayLog] == [(br, k, 1, b.mirrorLog[0][4]), (br, k, 1, b.tasks[k].task.clue(1)[1])]
assert b.relayLog[0][5] == b.mirrorLog[0] and b.relayLog[1][5] == b.mirrorLog[1]
assert relaySource(b, b.shareLog[0])[1] == liar and relaySource(b, b.shareLog[1])[1] == h   # the liar's lie, relayed
assert relaySource(b, b.relayLog[0]) == b.mirrorLog[0] and relaySource(ColonyBoardEnv(1, 8, **kw), b.shareLog[0]) is None
assert b.shareLog[0][6] and not b.shareLog[1][6] and b.counts['solved'] == 1 and b.tasks[k].solvedBy == solver
assert b._creditTo(solver, k) == [(br, 2), (h, 2)]
assert rews[-1] == 0.5 * v and b.pending[br] == 0.25 * v and b.pending[h] == 0.25 * v
c, *_ = play('contest')
assert c.pending[br] == 0.25 * v and c.pending[h] == 0.25 * v
# without the bridge board (ColonyBoardEnv: the relays are plain shares) the bridge takes the whole credit share
cb, *_ = play('credit', ColonyBoardEnv)
assert cb.pending[br] == (0.5 * v if solver not in cb.tasks[k].holders[1] else 0) and cb.pending[h] == 0
# 'individual': every reward equals ColonyBoardEnv's; mirror shares earn nothing
ib, *_, irews = play('individual')
_, *_, cirews = play('individual', ColonyBoardEnv)
assert irews == cirews == [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, v] and not ib.pending.any()
# a non-bridge's share of a mirror value is no relay (its validity is parse's: T2)
b2 = BridgeBoardEnv(1800, 16, guardSlots=range(4, 8), squads=4, nLiar=4, couple=0.25, bridges=1, **kw)
k2 = next(k for k in b2.open if k in b2.coupled)
s, s2 = b2.coupled[k2]
b2.apply(min(b2.tasks[k2].holders[1]), ('share', (k2, 1, b2.tasks[k2].task.clue(1)[1])), 1)
other = next(i for i in range(8, 16) if i % 4 == s and i not in b2.bridgeSet)
b2.apply(other, ('share', (k2, 1, b2.tasks[k2].task.clue(1)[1])), 2)
assert len(b2.shareLog) == 1 and b2.relayLog == [] and relaySource(b2, b2.shareLog[0]) is None


# couple guard (spec review, 2026-11-10): a bridge key without `couple` is refused, never coupled at the 0.25 default
from explRL.clue_colony import checkOptions
from explRL.colony_grid import WORLD18
for w in (dict(squads=8, bridges=0), dict(squads=8, bridges=1), dict(squads=8, bridgeGuard=True)):
    try:
        checkOptions(dict(WORLD18, colony=True, guards=16, **w), 64, 16); raise AssertionError(w)
    except ValueError:
        pass
assert checkOptions(dict(WORLD18, colony=True, guards=16, squads=8, couple=0.25, bridges=1), 64, 16)
