# hand-built rows: damage won back and cost without liars against the plain board, the waiting rate (answers) by liar count and
# lifetime and its slope, regret with the threshold chosen per liar count, the core measures and the coverage check
import json
from explRL.rl19_measures import *
R = lambda m, t, **k: dict(level=f'{m}|{t}', **k)
rows = [R('warm', f'plaingL{n}T{L}', welfareHonest=0.4 - 0.025 * n) for n in GATE_LIARS for L in (15, 30)]
rows += [R('warm', f'plaingL0T{L}', welfareHonest=0.4, honestPooled=0.5, welfare=0.3) for L in (15, 30)]
rows += [R('a', f'gL{n}T{L}', welfareHonest=0.4 - 0.01 * n, waitAnswers=2 + n + (L == 15), usedAnswers=20, honestPooled=0.46,
          welfare=0.28, contestLags=json.dumps([1.0] * (n + 1)), misinformedFirst=n, honestTurns=100, liarFirst=2, uncorrected=1,
          sameWrong=1, wrongHonest=4) for n in GATE_LIARS for L in (15, 30)]
ix = index(rows)
assert abs(damage(ix, 'a', gatePairs(4)) - (1 - 0.04 / 0.1)) < 1e-12 and abs(waitSlope(waitCurve(ix, 'a')) - 0.05) < 1e-12
assert waitCurve(ix, 'a')[0] == 0.125 and abs(lifeGap(ix, 'a') - 0.05) < 1e-12 and np.isnan(waitSlope({0: 0.1, 2: NAN}))
assert waitGrid(ix, 'a')['L4T15'] == 7 / 20 and waitGrid(ix, 'a')['L4T30'] == 6 / 20
assert abs(cost0(ix, 'a') - 0.04) < 1e-12 and abs(cost0(ix, 'a', k='welfare') - 0.02) < 1e-12        # the plain board minus the model
assert lags(ix, 'a', ['gL2T15', 'gL8T30']) == [1.0] * 12
# regret: the best threshold is chosen at each liar count (K 1 without liars, K 3 with 8), not once for the whole grid
rows += [R('warm', f'k{K}L{n}T{L}', welfareHonest=0.4 - 0.01 * n + 0.01 * (K - 1) * (n / 4 - 1)) for K in (1, 2, 3) for n in GATE_LIARS for L in (15, 30)]
want = np.mean([max(0.01 * (K - 1) * (n / 4 - 1) for K in (1, 2, 3)) for n in GATE_LIARS])
assert abs(regret(index(rows), 'a') - want) < 1e-12 and want > max(np.mean([0.01 * (K - 1) * (n / 4 - 1) for n in GATE_LIARS]) for K in (1, 2, 3))
M = runMeasures(index(rows), 'a')
assert M['timeToContest'] == 1.0 and M['gullibility'] == np.mean(range(2, 9, 2)) / 100 and M['suppression'] == 0.5 and M['errorCorr'] == 0.25
try:
    coverage(index(rows), ['a'], seeds=1)
    raise AssertionError('incomplete rows accepted')
except ValueError as e:
    assert 'short of the grid' in str(e)

text:
Sequences
Six waves by board position. Waves 1-2 run one cell per team (keyed without the arm) and copy its row into each arm, since three parallel live calls of the same request would all be paid (the response cache stores a reply only after its call). Wave b >= 3 runs board b of every team and arm, its record built from that arm’s boards 1 to b-1. Rows go to runs.csv (with arm), each board’s lines to records.jsonl and the turn logs to turns/; a rerun skips every board already in runs.csv, so an interrupted run resumes. alongside grids (P2, P21-14) join the first wave that runs, in the same pool, and their rows go to <name>.csv once every cell has come back (a grid whose file exists is not run again; a partial one is, its finished boards from the cache); gate(rows) after wave 2 returns the reasons to stop before wave 3 (none: go on).

# test_targeted (AC-4, FR-A3): on a full 16-agent board 1 with rule agents (numpy), no lie lands on a clue a failure guard
# holds; whenever a clue a success guard holds (and no failure guard) is open, the lie lands on one; the liars lie on
# exactly ClueLiar's turns (every odd turn with a candidate)
import json, tempfile
from explRL.a2_cols import guardIds
from explRL.colony_agents import memberClass
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig, makeClient
from explRL.clue_runs import runClue

class Watched(TargetedLiar):
    def choose(self, b, t):
        cand = self.candidates(b) if self.turn % 2 == 0 else None          # the next turn is odd: it will lie if it can
        a = super().choose(b, t)
        self.seen.append((self.turn, cand, a))
        return a

for team, bb in ((2190, 1), (2100, 2), (2103, 1)):
    c = boardCell21(team, bb, 'own')
    cfg, w = LLMConfig.fromDict(c['cfg']), c['cfg']['world']
    assert set(w['targets'][0]) | set(w['targets'][1]) == set(range(4, 8))
    board, ch = clueSetup(cfg, c['seed'])
    rngs = spawnRngs(c['seed'] + 3000, 4)
    liars = [Watched(ch, r, *w['targets']) for r in rngs]
    for m in liars:
        m.seen = []
    members = liars + [memberClass(w, i, 4)(ch, r) for i, r in zip(range(4, 16), spawnRngs(c['seed'] + 1000, 16)[4:])]
    runTurns(members, board, 40)
    hit, avoid, n = set(w['targets'][0]), set(w['targets'][1]), 0
    for m in liars:
        for turn, cand, a in m.seen:
            lied = a[0] == 'share'
            assert lied == bool(turn % 2 and cand), (turn, cand, a)        # ClueLiar's cadence
            if lied:
                k, j, _ = a[1]
                hs = set(board.tasks[k].holders[j])
                assert not hs & avoid and (k, j) in cand
                n += 1
                if any(hit & set(board.tasks[kk].holders[jj]) for kk, jj in cand):
                    assert hs & hit
    assert n > 20
    assert not any(set(board.tasks[s[2]].holders[s[3]]) & avoid for s in board.shareLog if s[1] < 4)


# test_records21 (AC-6): the board line on boards 1-2 in every arm (no record); from board 3 the own line counts only the
# agent's own contests and followers, the shared line the team totals (the same for every slot, no identity), none only
# the board line; boards 1-2 are identical cells in the three arms; records follow the identity across seatings
hist = [dict(board=1, contests=[0, 2] + [0] * 10, followed=[0, 1] + [0] * 10),
        dict(board=2, contests=[1] + [0] * 10 + [3], followed=[1] + [0] * 10 + [2])]
for b in (1, 2):
    cs = [boardCell21(2100, b, a) for a in ('none', 'shared', 'own')]
    assert cs[0] == cs[1] == cs[2] and cs[0]['level'] == f'common|b{b}'
    assert {t for _, t in cs[0]['cfg']['world']['slotLines']} == {f'This is board {b} of 6 played by the same team.'}
none, shared, own = (dict(recordLines(a, hist, 3, 2100)) for a in ('none', 'shared', 'own'))
assert set(none) == set(range(4, 16)) and set(none.values()) == {'This is board 3 of 6 played by the same team.'}
assert set(shared.values()) == {'This is board 3 of 6 played by the same team. Team record on the earlier boards: board 1: '
    'teammates contested 2 false values, and teammates then answered those subtasks correctly 1 time; board 2: teammates '
    'contested 4 false values, and teammates then answered those subtasks correctly 3 times.'}
seat = seating(2100, 3)
for s, a in enumerate(seat):
    want = {0: (0, 0, 1, 1), 1: (2, 1, 0, 0), 11: (0, 0, 3, 2)}.get(a, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    assert own[4 + s] == ('This is board 3 of 6 played by the same team. Your record on the earlier boards: board 1: you '
        f"contested {_count(want[0], 'false value')}, and teammates then answered those subtasks correctly {_count(want[1], 'time')}; "
        f"board 2: you contested {_count(want[2], 'false value')}, and teammates then answered those subtasks correctly {_count(want[3], 'time')}."), (a, own[4 + s])
c3 = {a: boardCell21(2100, 3, a, hist) for a in ('none', 'shared', 'own')}
assert {c['level'] for c in c3.values()} == {'none|b3', 'shared|b3', 'own|b3'} and 'targets' not in c3['own']['cfg']['world']
strip = lambda c: {k: v for k, v in c['cfg']['world'].items() if k != 'slotLines'}
assert strip(c3['none']) == strip(c3['shared']) == strip(c3['own']) and c3['own']['cfg']['world']['volunteer'] is True
try:
    recordLines('own', hist[:1], 3, 2100)
    raise AssertionError('a gap in the history must fail')
except AssertionError as e:
    assert 'history' in str(e)


# test_board21 (FR-A4): without targets, runBoard21's row holds runClue's row and its turn log is runClue's (the fake
# client, a short volunteer board); with targets (board 1), the liars never post on a failure guard's clue, and the
# row carries A2's, Stage 3's and Phase 19's columns with the identity keys
from explRL.colony3 import ARMS3
c = colonyCell('t', 'colonyVolunteer', 16, 1800, 'independent', arms=ARMS3)
c['cfg']['turns'] = 3
cfg = LLMConfig.fromDict(c['cfg'])
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    r0, l0 = runClue(cfg, 1800, makeClient(cfg, dict(kind='fake', cache=d)))
    r1, l1 = runBoard21(cfg, 1800, makeClient(cfg, dict(kind='fake', cache=d)))
    assert l0 == l1 and all(r1[0][k] == v or (v != v and r1[0][k] != r1[0][k]) for k, v in r0[0].items())
    c1 = boardCell21(2190, 1, 'own')
    c1['cfg']['turns'] = 6
    cfg1 = LLMConfig.fromDict(c1['cfg'])
    rows, log = runBoard21(cfg1, c1['seed'], makeClient(cfg1, dict(kind='fake', cache=d)))
r = rows[0]
assert r['liarOnFailure'] == 0 and r['pos'] == 0 and r['seqId'] == 2190 and {'volunteers', 'specIndex', 'misinformedFirst', 'idGuarding'} <= set(r)
assert sorted(json.loads(r['agents'])[4:]) == list(range(4, 16)) and json.loads(r['agents'])[:4] == [0, 1, 2, 3]
assert len({x['agent'] for x in log}) == 12 and all(x['agent'] >= 4 for x in log)


# test_sequences21 (AC-7, FR-B4, P21-14): with the fake client, 2 teams x 3 arms play waves; boards 1-2 run one cell per
# team and are copied into each arm; board b's record comes from that arm's boards 1..b-1; a resume after board 4 runs
# only boards 5-6; P2's cells run once, in the first wave's pool; a gate after wave 2 stops before wave 3
from pathlib import Path
from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV
from explRL.fix_grid import fixCell

short = lambda c: dict(c, cfg=dict(c['cfg'], turns=2))
arms = ('none', 'shared', 'own')
p2 = [short(dict(fixCell('a2drop', 'baseline', 8, 900, 2), level='drop|liar'))]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    spec = dict(kind='fake', cache=str(Path(d) / 'cache'))
    R = runSequences21([2100, 2101], arms, spec, Path(d) / 'seq', workers=2, boards=4, edit=short, alongside=[('p2', p2)])
    assert R['ran'] == [(1, 2), (2, 2), (3, 6), (4, 6)] and R['stopped'] is None and len(R['alongside']['p2']) == 1
    rows = R['rows']
    assert len(rows) == 2 * 3 * 4 and {_key(r) for r in rows} == {(t, a, b) for t in (2100, 2101) for a in arms for b in range(1, 5)}
    for t in (2100, 2101):
        for b in (1, 2):
            same = [r for r in rows if _key(r)[0] == t and _key(r)[2] == b]
            assert len({json.dumps({k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != 'arm'}, sort_keys=True, default=str) for r in same}) == 1
    R2 = runSequences21([2100, 2101], arms, spec, Path(d) / 'seq', workers=2, boards=6, edit=short, alongside=[('p2', p2)])
    assert R2['ran'] == [(5, 6), (6, 6)] and R2['alongside'] == {} and len(R2['rows']) == 2 * 3 * 6
    assert len(readCSV(Path(d) / 'seq' / 'p2.csv')) == 1
    disk = readCSV(Path(d) / 'seq' / 'runs.csv')
    assert {_key(r) for r in disk} == {_key(r) for r in R2['rows']} and len(disk) == 36
    recs = [json.loads(x) for x in (Path(d) / 'seq' / 'records.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    assert len(recs) == 2 + 2 + 6 * 4
    for rec in recs:
        t, b, arm = rec['team'], rec['board'], rec['level'].split('|')[0]
        h = [historyEntry(r) for r in sorted((r for r in disk if _key(r)[:2] == (t, 'own' if arm == 'common' else arm) and _key(r)[2] < b), key=_key)]
        assert [tuple(x) for x in rec['lines']] == list(recordLines('none' if b <= 2 else arm, h, b, t)), rec
    from explRL.llm_sched import runWorkload as _rw
    import explRL.llm_sched as _ls
    def lossy(grids, *a, **k):                    # a run that loses the P2 board (as a cap refusal would)
        res = _rw(grids, *a, **k)
        return dict(res, rows=[r for r in res['rows'] if r['study'] == 'a2'])
    _ls.runWorkload = lossy
    try:
        R4 = runSequences21([2103], arms, spec, Path(d) / 'lossy', workers=2, boards=1, edit=short, alongside=[('p2', p2)])
    finally:
        _ls.runWorkload = _rw
    assert R4['stopped'] == 'p2: 1 boards missing' and not (Path(d) / 'lossy' / 'p2.csv').exists()
    R5 = runSequences21([2103], arms, spec, Path(d) / 'lossy', workers=2, boards=2, edit=short, alongside=[('p2', p2)])
    assert R5['ran'] == [(2, 1)] and len(R5['alongside']['p2']) == 1 and (Path(d) / 'lossy' / 'p2.csv').exists()
    R3 = runSequences21([2102], arms, spec, Path(d) / 'gated', workers=2, edit=short, gate=lambda rows: ['manipulation check failed'])
    assert R3['ran'] == [(1, 1), (2, 1)] and R3['stopped'] == 'manipulation check failed' and len(R3['rows']) == 6

import numpy as np
from collections import deque
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_close
from explRL.adversary import ReportLog, Liar, FreeRider, Saboteur, LeadLiar, LeadFreeRider, LeadSaboteur, BAD
from explRL.harness import Blackboard, MessageBus, Lead
from explRL.harness_runs import benchWorld
from explRL.multi import spawnRngs

def world(n):
    w = benchWorld(nPatches=1, nDanger=1, intake=(1.0,), patchSites=[0], dangerSites=[1], noise=0.0, Tmove=None)
    w.reset(0, n); return w

# liar on the blackboard: harvests at the patch (site 0) and reports -dangerCost; at the danger site (1) reports c;
# its own beliefs stay honest, and its white-box score is the gap between the two
w = world(2); w.loc = [0, 1]
bb = Blackboard(w.L, n=2)
liars = [Liar(bb), Liar(bb)]
for i, m in enumerate(liars): m.id = i
liars[0].event(w, 0.0); liars[1].event(w, 0.0)
S, C = bb.view(-1, 1.0)
test_close((S[0] / C[0], S[1] / C[1]), (-w.dangerCost, w.c))
test_close((liars[0].rates[0][0], liars[1].rates[1][0]), (w.c, -w.dangerCost))       # honest own beliefs
test_close(liars[0].whiteScore(), w.c + w.dangerCost)

# liar with messages: sends its worst own place as worth c
w = world(2)
bus = MessageBus(2, k=1, rngs=spawnRngs(1, 2))
lm = Liar(bus); lm.id, lm._world, lm._t = 0, w, 0.0
lm.rates = [deque() for _ in range(w.L)]; lm.rates[1].append(-2.6)
lm.learn({'location': 0}, 0, 0.5, {'kind': 'stay', 'harvest': 0.5, 'dur': 1.0})
test_eq([(j, round(v, 3)) for _, j, v, _ in bus.take(1)], [(1, w.c)])

# free-rider: only reported-positive locations, best combined estimate, stays put otherwise, never writes;
# saboteur: always the top reported location
w = world(3); w.loc = [10, 10, 10]
bb = Blackboard(w.L, n=3)
fr, sb = FreeRider(bb), Saboteur(bb)
for i, m in enumerate((fr, sb)): m.id, m._world, m._t = i, w, 0.0
obs = w.observe(0)
test_eq(fr.act(obs), 10); test_eq(sb.act(obs), 10)                                   # nothing reported: stay
bb.write(2, 3, 0.5, 0.0); bb.write(2, 5, 2.0, 0.0)
test_eq(sb.act(obs), 5); test_eq(fr.act(obs), 5)
fr.rates[5].extend([-2.6, -2.6, -2.6])                                               # its own bad experience at 5
test_eq(fr.act(obs), 3); test_eq(sb.act(obs), 5)
fr.learn({'location': 3}, 3, 0.5, {'kind': 'stay', 'harvest': 0.5, 'dur': 1.0})
test_eq(bb.stats[0]['written'], 0)
nc = FreeRider(None); nc.id, nc._world, nc._t = 0, w, 0.0
test_eq(nc.act(obs), 10)                                                             # no channel: stays put

# lead variants: the liar reports its lie, the free-rider stays silent, the saboteur crowds the most-assigned place
lead = Lead(w.L, 3, lam=0.0)
ll, lf, ls = LeadLiar(lead), LeadFreeRider(lead), LeadSaboteur(lead)
for i, m in enumerate((ll, lf, ls)): m.id, m._t, m._world = i, 0.0, w
ll.learn({'location': 0}, 0, 0.85, {'kind': 'stay', 'harvest': 0.85, 'dur': 1.0, 'nHere': 1})
S, C = lead.table.view(-1, 0.0); test_close(S[0] / C[0], -w.dangerCost)
lf.learn({'location': 0}, 0, 0.85, {'kind': 'stay', 'harvest': 0.85, 'dur': 1.0, 'nHere': 1})
test_eq(lead.stats[1]['written'], 0)
lead.assigned = [7, 4, None]
test_eq(ls.act(w.observe(2)), 4)                                                     # one each: ties to the lower index
lead.assigned = [7, 7, None]; test_eq(ls.act(w.observe(2)), 7)
test_eq(set(BAD), {'liar', 'freerider', 'saboteur'})

    plan:dict={'version': 1, 'frozen': True, 'plan': 'specs/multiagent/phase24/', 'model': 'claude-haiku-5-5', 'world': {'m': 2, 'r': 2, 'R': 30, 'value': (1, 2, 3), 'life': 30, 'penalty': 0.5}, 'turns': 40, 'channel': 'blackboard', 'memory': 'full', 'effort': 'low', 'arms': {'bridge1': {'colony': True, 'guards': 'quarter', 'squads': 8, 'couple': 0.25, 'bridges': 1}, 'bridgeRole': {'colony': True, 'guards': 'quarter', 'squads': 8, 'couple': 0.25, 'bridges': 1, 'bridgeRole': True}}, 'cells': {'liars': {'bridge1': [1810, 1811, 1812, 1813, 1814, 1815, 1816, 1817], 'bridgeRole': [1810, 1811, 1812, 1813, 1814, 1815, 1816, 1817]}}, 'seeds': [1810, 1811, 1812, 1813, 1814, 1815, 1816, 1817], 'fault': 'scripted ClueLiar in the first 16 slots (MirrorLiar: also on mirrors), guards the next 16', 'hypotheses': {'H24_1': 'Gate C1c (i), effective: honestPooled, bridgeRole - bridge1, N 64, independent liars, seeds 1810-1817 paired: one-sided exact sign-flip > 0, alpha 0.05 (smallest p 1/256)', 'H24_2': 'Gate C1c (ii), safe (non-inferiority): contamination, bridgeRole - bridge1, N 64, independent liars, seeds 1810-1817 paired: the 95th percentile of 2,000 paired bootstrap means < 0.05'}, 'gate': {'parts': ['H24_1', 'H24_2'], 'arm': 'bridgeRole', 'base': 'bridge1', 'alpha': 0.05, 'metric': 'honestPooled', 'safety': 'contamination', 'margin': 0.05, 'quantile': 95, 'decides': {'passes': "A1's bridged arms use a dedicated bridge without evidence (bridgeRole), in place of bridge1 (amends P19-8)", 'fails': 'A1 keeps bridge1 (P19-8 as amended by C1); the dedicated role is not adopted'}}, 'robustness': 'part (i) on welfareHonest; an estimate of the opposite sign marks it not robust', 'why': "Gate C1b asked (2026-11-12): bridgeFix - bridge1 -0.003 (p 0.62), safer; bridgeRole was the best coupled arm on C1b's 5 exploratory boards, chosen after seeing them, so the user asked for this confirmation before A1 adopts it", 'calls': {'basis': "C1b's 5 paired boards, seeds 1800-1804 (exploratory): bridgeRole beat bridge1 on all 5", 'pilotOnly': {'H24_1': {'call': 'passes', 'estimate': 0.0207}, 'H24_2': {'call': 'holds', 'estimate': -0.1132}, 'gate': 'passes'}, 'everyDesignHelps': {'H24_1': {'call': 'passes'}, 'H24_2': {'call': 'holds'}, 'gate': 'passes'}}, 'noPilot': 'both arms ran at this size in C1 and C1b with invalid replies under 0.2% (the user, 2026-11-12)', 'costRule': {'rule': 'report and wait (P20-8): the user approved the estimate before the run', 'ceiling': 12.0, 'estimate': (10.5, 11.03), 'perBoard': {'bridge1': 0.651, 'bridgeRole': 0.662}, 'allowance': 1.05}, 'stop': 'invalid replies >= 5% or the monthly cap: stop and ask', 'approved': {'design': '2026-11-12', 'estimate': (10.5, 11.03)}, 'cap': 250.0, 'capNote': 'per calendar month (the user, 2026-11-09)', 'dirs': {'main': 'results/multiagent/colony/c1c'}, 'nboot': 2000, 'confirmatory': True},
    nboot:int=2000, metric:str='honestPooled'

Gate C1c over the 8 paired boards. Part (i): arm - base in metric, one-sided exact sign-flip, passes at p < alpha with a positive estimate. Part (ii): arm - base in contamination, holds when the 95th percentile of the paired bootstrap means is below the margin. Verdict: passes (both) or fails, with what it decides for A1.



# test_c1c_gate (FR-4, FR-5): synthetic rows: a clear gain that is safe passes; no gain fails; a gain that is less safe fails;
# missing cells refuse; the report writes the verdict and scores the calls
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path


def rows24(gain, dcont, noise=0.004):
    out = []
    for a in ARMS24:
        for i, s in enumerate(SEEDS24):
            e = (i % 3 - 1) * noise
            hp = 0.18 + e + (gain if a == 'bridgeRole' else 0)
            out.append(dict(level=f'{a}|independent', seed=s, N=64, honestPooled=hp, welfareHonest=hp + 0.05, calls=1920.0, invalid=1.0,
                            contamination=0.33 + e + (dcont if a == 'bridgeRole' else 0), relaysPerBridgeTurn=0.1, arrivalConfirmed=0.5,
                            coupledContamination=0.7, crossContamination=0.01, inTokPerCallBridge=1100.0, cost=0.65))
    return out


S = c1cSummary(rows24(0.02, -0.1), nboot=200)
assert S['gate']['verdict'] == 'passes' and S['gate']['i']['p'] == 1 / 256 and S['gate']['robust'] and S['boards'] == 16
assert all(c['right'] for cs in S['calls'].values() for c in cs.values()) and abs(S['cost'] - 16 * 0.65) < 1e-9
assert gateC1c(rows24(0.0, -0.1), nboot=200)['verdict'] == 'fails'                      # no gain
G = gateC1c(rows24(0.02, 0.08), nboot=200)
assert G['i']['passes'] and not G['ii']['holds'] and G['verdict'] == 'fails'            # effective but less safe
assert gateC1c(rows24(-0.02, -0.1), nboot=200)['verdict'] == 'fails'                     # worse
S0 = c1cSummary(rows24(0.0, -0.1), nboot=200)
assert not S0['calls']['pilotOnly']['H24_1']['right'] and S0['calls']['pilotOnly']['H24_2']['right']
try:
    c1cSummary(rows24(0.02, -0.1)[1:]); assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
p = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / 'report.md'
txt = writeC1c(p, S, dict(planHash='x', commit='y'))
assert 'Gate C1c: passes.' in txt and 'bridgeRole' in txt and p.read_text() == txt + '\n'

import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

import numpy as np

from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV, writeCSV
from explRL.clue_runs import runClueAny
from explRL.fix_grid import FIX_PLAN, fixGrid, fixPilotGrid, fixQuick, profileGrid, profilePilotGrid, profileQuick
from explRL.coop_grid import coopHash
from explRL.fix_report import figFix, fixLogMetrics, fixSummaries, writeFix
from explRL.llm_budget import PRICES, Budget
from explRL.llm_grid import HAIKU
from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig, makeClient
from explRL.llm_sched import mergeTiming, runWorkload, timingSummary
from explRL.profile_runs import runProfile
from explRL.train import demo_artifact_dir

FIX, VOTE = 'multiagent/fix', 'multiagent/profile'
WORKERS = min(8, os.cpu_count() or 1)
LLM_WORKERS, VOTE_WORKERS = 32, 16
CAP = 150.0
LLM = demo_artifact_dir(None, 'multiagent/llm')
LIVE = os.environ.get('EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE') == '1'
LIVE_SPEC = dict(kind='live', cache=str(LLM / 'cache'), cap=CAP, ledger=str(LLM / 'spend.jsonl'))
P11 = demo_artifact_dir('full', 'multiagent/clue')


def gitCommit():
    try:
        return subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or 'unknown'
    except OSError:
        return 'unknown'


def readLog(p):
    return [json.loads(x) for x in open(p)] if p.exists() else []


def collect(logs, out):
    "Concatenate the per-run turn logs (sorted by name) into turns.jsonl and remove them."
    with open(out / 'turns.jsonl', 'w') as f:
        for p in sorted(logs.glob('*.jsonl')) if logs.exists() else []:
            f.write(p.read_text())


def runFix(mode, grids, spec, workers):
    "The clue-board cells through runWorkload (runClueAny): runs.csv, turns.jsonl, timing.jsonl."
    out = demo_artifact_dir(mode, FIX)
    logs = out / 'turns'
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    res = runWorkload(grids, spec, workers, str(logs), run=runClueAny)
    wall = time.time() - t0
    writeCSV(res['rows'], out / 'runs.csv')
    collect(logs, out)
    res['timing'] = timingSummary(mergeTiming(logs, out / 'timing.jsonl'), wall)
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    return res, wall


def runVote(mode, cells, spec, workers):
    "The vote cells through runProfile (one client, batches of 100 episodes): runs.csv, turns.jsonl, timing.jsonl."
    out = demo_artifact_dir(mode, VOTE)
    logs = out / 'turns'
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    client = makeClient(LLMConfig.fromDict(cells[0]['cfg']), spec)
    t0 = time.time()
    rows = runProfile(cells, client, logs, workers=workers)
    wall = time.time() - t0
    writeCSV(rows, out / 'runs.csv')
    collect(logs, out)
    (out / 'timing.jsonl').write_text(''.join(json.dumps(x, sort_keys=True) + '\n' for x in client.timing))
    shutil.rmtree(logs, ignore_errors=True)
    return dict(rows=rows, timing=timingSummary(client.timing, wall), done=['vote'], refused=[], stopped=None), wall


def run(mode, grids, votes, spec, workers=None, voteWorkers=None, study='fixA', profileStudy='profileA'):
    "Run both workloads, then the report (report.md, fix.png, metrics.json) in both directories."
    live = spec.get('kind') == 'live'
    fres, fwall = runFix(mode, grids, spec, workers or (LLM_WORKERS if live else WORKERS))
    vres, vwall = runVote(mode, votes, spec, voteWorkers or (VOTE_WORKERS if live else WORKERS))
    rows, prows = fres['rows'], vres['rows']
    fo, vo = demo_artifact_dir(mode, FIX), demo_artifact_dir(mode, VOTE)
    p11 = readCSV(P11 / 'runs.csv') if (P11 / 'runs.csv').exists() else []
    S = fixSummaries(rows, p11, fixLogMetrics(readLog(fo / 'turns.jsonl')), prows, study, profileStudy)
    allRows = rows + prows
    meta = dict(mode=mode, planHash=coopHash(FIX_PLAN), commit=gitCommit(), model=HAIKU, cap=CAP, wall=fwall + vwall,
                pricesChecked=PRICES[HAIKU]['checked'], cost=float(sum(r['cost'] for r in allRows)),
                calls=int(sum(r['calls'] for r in allRows)), spent=Budget(CAP, spec['ledger']).spent() if spec.get('ledger') else 0.0)
    for out, res, parts in ((fo, fres, ('A1', 'A2', 'A3')), (vo, vres, ('A3',))):
        writeFix(out / 'report.md', S, meta, parts)
        if any(S[p] for p in parts):
            figFix(out, S, parts)
        (out / 'metrics.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(meta, done=res['done'], refused=res['refused'], stopped=res['stopped'],
                                                          timing=res['timing'], plan=FIX_PLAN),
                                                     indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str) + '\n')
        if live:                               # keep the live run's metrics and timing; a cached rerun overwrites the others
            for f in ('metrics.json', 'timing.jsonl'):
                if not (out / f.replace('.', '_live.')).exists():
                    shutil.copy(out / f, out / f.replace('.', '_live.'))
    print(f"{mode}: {len(rows)} board rows, {len(prows)} vote rows, {meta['calls']} calls, ${meta['cost']:.2f} for these "
          f"runs, ${meta['spent']:.2f} spent in all, {meta['wall']:.0f} s; stopped: {fres['stopped']}")
    return rows, prows, S, meta

import json, math, os, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from explRL.llm_runs import *
from explRL.llm_budget import BudgetExceeded
from explRL.llm_client import LLMClient, ResponseCache
from explRL.llm_fake import FakeClient, fakeReply

def same(a, b):
    return json.dumps(a, sort_keys=True, default=str).replace('NaN', 'nan') == json.dumps(b, sort_keys=True, default=str).replace('NaN', 'nan')

cfg = LLMConfig(task='board', channel='messages', N=8, B=200, world=dict(life=20))
assert LLMConfig.fromDict(json.loads(json.dumps(cfg.asDict()))) == cfg and cfg.turnsPerAgent() == 25
assert LLMConfig(turns=7).turnsPerAgent() == 7


def fake():
    return LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', client=FakeClient(fakeReply))

# rounds and squads (speedup plan Part B): homes in the prompt, home share in the row; rounds decide on a snapshot
c = fake()
rows, log = runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=5, protocol='rounds', window=5.0, squads=2, beta=1.0,
                             world=dict(tStay=5.0)), 3, c)
assert 0 <= rows[0]['homeShare'] <= 1 and rows[0]['calls'] == 4 * 5 + 4
assert all('home range is the locations' in q['system'][0]['text'] for q in c.client.requests)
r0 = runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=5, world=dict(tStay=5.0)), 3, fake())[0][0]
assert 'homeShare' not in r0 and same(r0, runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=4, turns=5, protocol='rounds', window=0.0, world=dict(tStay=5.0)), 3, fake())[0][0])

# text foraging: N agents x turns calls plus one belief call each; Phase 8 metrics where they apply
c = fake()
rows, log = runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=2, turns=6), 3, c)
r = rows[0]
assert len(rows) == 1 and r['calls'] == 2 * 6 + 2 and len(c.client.requests) == 14 and len(log) == 14
assert r['invalid'] == 0 and r['refusals'] == 0 and 0 < r['reportShare'] < 1 and r['cost'] > 0 and 'cacheHit' not in r
for k in ('welfare', 'welfareHonest', 'rmrt', 'ifdMean', 'discoveries', 'freeRiding', 'diversity', 'beliefError',
          'exploreShare', 'exploreSpread', 'soShare', 'inputTokens', 'outputTokens', 'promptCacheRead', 'tEnd'):
    assert k in r, k
assert r['welfare'] == r['welfareHonest'] and sum(x['kind'] == 'beliefs' for x in log) == 2
assert abs(r['teamWelfare'] - r['welfare'] * 2 * 6) < 1e-9          # team total = per agent-turn x N x turns
assert r['tEnd'] < 40 and 'teamRate_0' not in r                       # shorter than one move period: no complete period
assert same(rows, runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=2, turns=6), 3, fake())[0])      # deterministic

# the task board: solves, wrong answers, duplicate turns; no belief calls
rows, log = runLLM(LLMConfig(task='board', channel='blackboard', N=2, turns=6, difficulty=0), 3, fake())
assert rows[0]['calls'] == 12 and {'solved', 'wrong', 'duplicates', 'soShare'} <= set(rows[0]) and 'rmrt' not in rows[0]
assert abs(rows[0]['teamWelfare'] - rows[0]['welfare'] * 2 * 6) < 1e-9
r30 = runLLM(LLMConfig(task='board', channel='none', N=2, turns=30, difficulty=0), 4, fake())[0][0]
assert [k for k in r30 if k.startswith('teamRate_')] == ['teamRate_0', 'teamRate_1', 'teamRate_2']
assert abs(sum(r30[f'teamRate_{k}'] for k in range(3)) * 10 - r30['teamWelfare']) < 1e-9

# a scripted liar takes slot 0 and makes no calls; honest welfare leaves it out
for task in ('forage', 'board'):
    rows, log = runLLM(LLMConfig(task=task, channel='blackboard', N=3, nLiar=1, turns=4), 5, fake())
    assert rows[0]['calls'] == 2 * 4 + 2 * (task == 'forage') and {x['agent'] for x in log} == {1, 2}

# equal budget: B / N turns per agent
rows, _ = runLLM(LLMConfig(N=4, B=8, channel='none'), 1, fake())
assert rows[0]['calls'] == 8 + 4

# persistence: one row per episode on world seeds 10 000 + 100 s + e; lessons (last notes) carried when asked
c = fake()
rows, log = runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='blackboard', N=2, turns=3, episodes=2, lessons=True), 7, c)
assert [r['episode'] for r in rows] == [0, 1] and {x['episode'] for x in log} == {0, 1}
systems = [q['system'][0]['text'] for q in c.client.requests]
assert not any('Lessons' in s for s in systems[:8]) and all('Lessons' in s for s in systems[8:])
w, env, _ = setup(LLMConfig(), 10000 + 700 + 1)
assert env.names == locationNames(64, 10701)

# the run's estimate is checked against what is left before its first live call
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
c = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', budget=Budget(1e-6, tmp / 'spend.jsonl'), client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
try:
    runLLM(LLMConfig(N=2, turns=50), 0, c); raise AssertionError('not refused')
except BudgetExceeded:
    assert len(c.client.requests) == 0

# with a response cache, a rerun sends nothing and gives the same rows
cache = ResponseCache(tmp / 'cache')
c1 = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', cache=cache, client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
r1, l1 = runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='messages', N=3, turns=4), 2, c1)
c2 = LLMClient('claude-haiku-5-5', cache=cache, client=FakeClient(fakeReply))
r2, l2 = runLLM(LLMConfig(channel='messages', N=3, turns=4), 2, c2)
assert len(c2.client.requests) == 0 and c2.hits == c1.calls and c2.calls == 0
assert same(r1, r2) and same(l1, l2)            # rows and turn log do not depend on the cache (AC-9)

# live clients need the opt-in variable and a cap; fake is the default
os.environ.pop('EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE', None)
for spec in (dict(kind='live', cap=1.0), ):
    try:
        makeClient(LLMConfig(), spec); raise AssertionError
    except RuntimeError as e:
        assert 'EXPLRL_LLM_LIVE' in str(e)
assert isinstance(makeClient(LLMConfig()).client, FakeClient)

# a cell: keys, flattened config, turn log written per cell
cell = dict(study='main', factor='main', level='forage', N=2, seed=4, runner='llm', logDir=str(tmp / 'turns'),
            cfg=LLMConfig(channel='hierarchical', N=2, turns=3, world=dict(Tmove=30.0)).asDict())
rows = runLLMCell(cell)
assert rows[0]['study'] == 'main' and rows[0]['world.Tmove'] == 30.0 and rows[0]['budget'] == 'turns'

# test_b3_defaults (AC-2, FR-A3, NFR-1): with world['b3'] absent or all default, numpy cells at 8, 16, 32 and 64 agents
# (plain, counting board, guards, squads; liars and clean) give rows, board logs and answers equal to replay's, and no b3Rng
import copy
from explRL.bridge_grid import ARMS20, c1Cell

def _same(a, b):
    assert a.rows == b.rows and a.answers == b.answers and a.nLiar == b.nLiar
    assert a.board.submits == b.board.submits and a.board.shareLog == b.board.shareLog

def _cfg(c, b3=None):

cases = [colonyCell('t', a, N, 3000, f, 'numpy', arms=ARMS4) for a, N, f in

          ('failFlag', 16, 'independent'), ('plain', 16, 'error')]] + [c1Cell('t', 'bridge1', 3000, runner='numpy'),
         fixCell('scaleB', 'baseline', 32, 900, runner='numpy')]

# test_b3_behaviours (AC-3, FR-A2): trustOne, spread and shareAll on hand-built boards; only the members FR-A2 names change
from explRL.clue_agents import ClueBoard, ClueLiar, RuleAgent
from explRL.fix_grid import fixCell
from explRL.clue_runs import clueSetup
from explRL.colony_agents import ColonyAgent, GuardAgent, MistakenAgent

def _board(c, b3, seed=3000):
    cfg = _cfg(c, b3)
    b, ch = clueSetup(cfg, seed)
    b.advance(0.0)
    w, nL = cfg.world, cfg.nLiar
    ms = [faultClass(w)(ch, np.random.default_rng(i)) if i < nL else memberClass(w, i, nL)(ch, np.random.default_rng(i)) for i in range(cfg.N)]
    for i, m in enumerate(ms):
        m.id = i
    return b, ch, b3Members(w, stage4Members(w, ms), seed)

col = colonyCell('t', 'colonyGuards', 16, 3000, 'independent', 'numpy', arms=ARMS4)
P14 = fixCell('scaleB', 'baseline', 8, 900, runner='numpy')      # Phase 14's plain board: blackboard, one holder per clue
# trustOne: a one-sender leading value of a clue the agent does not hold is known at 1, not at 0; the same decision every turn
for p, expect in ((1.0, True), (0.0, False)):
    b, ch, ms = _board(col, dict(trustOne=p) if p else None)
    a = next(m for m in ms if type(m).__name__.endswith('ColonyAgent'))
    k = next(k for k in b.open if 0 not in b.held(a.id, k))
    ch.post(0 if a.id else 1, k, (0, b.tasks[k].task.primes[0], 1), 0.0)
    assert [0 in a.knownFor(b)[k] for _ in range(3)] == [expect] * 3, p
b, ch, ms = _board(col, dict(trustOne=0.5))
for m in ms[:4]:
    assert type(m) is ClueLiar                                # liars unchanged
assert all(isinstance(m, TrustOne) for m in ms[4:])           # guards and colony agents gain trustOne
a = ms[8]
for k in list(b.open)[:6]:
    if 0 not in b.held(a.id, k):
        ch.post(1, k, (0, b.tasks[k].task.primes[0], 1), 0.0)
first = {k: 0 in v for k, v in a.knownFor(b).items()}
assert all({k: 0 in v for k, v in a.knownFor(b).items()} == first for _ in range(5)) and len(a._trust) > 0
# spread: an open goes to a live subtask with the fewest openers
plain = colonyCell('t', 'plain', 16, 3000, 'clean', 'numpy', arms=ARMS4)
for c in (plain, col, P14):
    b, ch, ms = _board(c, dict(spread=1.0))
    a = next(m for m in ms if isinstance(m, Spread) and not isinstance(m, GuardAgent))
    b.opened = [int(b.open[0])] * len(b.opened)
    b.opened[a.id] = -1
    a._shareable = lambda *x: None                             # nothing to share: the base agent opens
    act = a.choose(b, 0.0)
    n = lambda x: sum(o == x for i, o in enumerate(b.opened) if i != a.id)
    live = [x for x in b.open if b.tasks[x].expire > 1.0 and x != b.opened[a.id]]
    assert act[0] == 'open' and act[1] != b.opened[a.id] and n(act[1]) == min(n(x) for x in live), (c['level'], act)
    assert not isinstance(a, TrustOne)                         # trustOne is not set
# spread never re-chooses the agent's own subtask, even when it is the least crowded (a stub base agent that always opens)
class _Opens:
    def knownFor(self, b):
        return {k: {} for k in b.open}
    def choose(self, b, t):
        return ('open', int(b.open[0]))
b, ch, ms = _board(plain, None)
s = type('S', (Spread, _Opens), {})()
s.id, s.b3, s.b3rng = 1, dict(spread=1.0), b3Rng(0, 1)
b.opened = [int(b.open[0])] * len(b.opened)
b.opened[1] = int(b.open[1])
assert all(s.choose(b, 0.0)[1] not in (b.open[0], b.open[1]) for _ in range(20))
# shareAll: a held clue whose subtask nobody has open is shared at 1, not at 0 (share 'needed')
for c in (plain, col, P14):
    got = {}
    for p in (0.0, 1.0):
        b, ch, ms = _board(c, dict(shareAll=p) if p else None)
        a = next(m for m in ms if isinstance(m, RuleAgent) and not isinstance(m, (ClueLiar, GuardAgent)))
        b.opened = [-1] * len(b.opened)
        kn = a.knownFor(b) if hasattr(a, 'knownFor') else known(a.id, b, a.channel)
        got[p] = a._shareable(b, kn, 0.0)
    assert got[0.0] is None and got[1.0] is not None and got[1.0][0] == 'share', (c['level'], got)
    assert a.share == 'needed'                                 # restored after the call
# mistaken members and guess: error-fault members unchanged; guess sets RuleAgent's argument, with no b3 generator
b, ch, ms = _board(colonyCell('t', 'plain', 16, 3000, 'error', 'numpy', arms=ARMS4), dict(spread=1.0, guess=0.2))
assert all(type(m) is MistakenAgent for m in ms[:4]) and all(m.guess == 0.2 and isinstance(m, Spread) for m in ms[4:])
b, ch, ms = _board(plain, dict(guess=0.3))
assert all(m.guess == 0.3 and type(m) is RuleAgent and not hasattr(m, 'b3rng') for m in ms)

def stream(code):
    "Run `code` in a fresh Python process, echoing its output here (GPU memory is freed when it ends); -> its exit code."
    import os, subprocess, sys
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-u', '-c', code], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    while chunk := os.read(p.stdout.fileno(), 4096):
        sys.stdout.write(chunk.decode(errors='replace'))
        sys.stdout.flush()
    return p.wait()


def packZip(name, dirs):
    "OUT / name: the files under `dirs` (no ckpt-* checkpoints)."
    import zipfile
    with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT / name, 'w') as z:
        for p in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')):
            rel = p.relative_to(OUT)
            if p.is_file() and rel.parts[0] in dirs and 'ckpt-' not in str(rel):
                z.write(p, rel)
    print(OUT / name, round((OUT / name).stat().st_size / 1e6, 1), 'MB')

text:
Phase 13 RL run (gpu; one session per run, about 3 hours)
One of RL13_PLAN’s five runs per session (credit seed 2, indpen seeds 1-2, credturn seeds 1-2; seed 1 = trainSeed 0, seed 2 = trainSeed 1): RL_PLAN v2’s settings with the arm’s changes (indpen: individual reward, a training-only cost of 2.5 per wrong answer, roll-back on a jump above 15% invalid replies; credturn: credit reward, per-turn advantages, the same cost and roll-back). Set ARM and SEED in the configuration cell first (restart the session between runs). A run resumes from its last checkpoint after a disconnection; a halted run (stopping rule or two roll-backs in a row) is not resumed. Note the GPU hours printed at the end.

from explRL.clue_rl import trainRL
from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter
from explRL.coop_grid import RL13_RUNS, rl13Config, rl13Name
assert RL13_PLAN['frozen'], 'freeze and commit RL13_PLAN before the Phase 13 runs'
assert (ARM, SEED) in RL13_RUNS, f'{ARM}_s{SEED} is not one of the Phase 13 runs {RL13_RUNS}'
WARM = OUT / 'warm_model'
if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    mergeAdapter(BASE, OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter', WARM)
t0 = time.time()
final = trainRL(rl13Config(ARM, SEED, str(WARM), str(RUNS13 / rl13Name(ARM, SEED))))
print(f'{rl13Name(ARM, SEED)}: {final}; this session {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours')

title: colab_clue_rl
section: Phase 13: all five runs in one session (gpu; about 15 hours; instead of the per-run section above)
text:
Phase 13: all five runs in one session (gpu; about 15 hours; instead of the per-run section above)
Trains RL13_PLAN’s five runs one after another, each in its own Python process, so each run’s GPU memory (vLLM’s engine included) is freed when it ends and no restart is needed between runs. Runs already finished (a final adapter or halted.json) are skipped, and an unfinished one resumes from its last checkpoint, so after a disconnect: restart, set-up, configuration, then this cell again. ARM and SEED are not used here. Each run’s output streams below (progress bar and one line per step); a run that fails stops the batch. To have no further manual steps, queue the Phase 13 evaluation and Pack cells after this one (Runtime -> Run after).

import os
import sys
import subprocess
from explRL.coop_grid import RL13_RUNS, rl13Name
assert RL13_PLAN['frozen'], 'freeze and commit RL13_PLAN before the Phase 13 runs'
ORDER = [('credturn', 1), ('indpen', 1), ('credturn', 2), ('indpen', 2), ('credit', 2)]   # the main test first
assert sorted(ORDER) == sorted(RL13_RUNS), (ORDER, RL13_RUNS)
WARM = OUT / 'warm_model'


def stream(code):
    "Run `code` in a fresh Python process, echoing its output (progress bar included) here; -> its exit code."
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-u', '-c', code], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    while chunk := os.read(p.stdout.fileno(), 4096):
        sys.stdout.write(chunk.decode(errors='replace'))
        sys.stdout.flush()
    return p.wait()


if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    assert stream(f"from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter; mergeAdapter({BASE!r}, {str(OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter')!r}, "
                  f"{str(WARM)!r})") == 0, 'merging the warm-start model failed'
for arm, seed in ORDER:
    name, d = rl13Name(arm, seed), RUNS13 / rl13Name(arm, seed)
    if (d / 'final').exists() or (d / 'halted.json').exists():
        print(f'{name}: already done, skipped')
        continue
    print(f'=== {name} ===', flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    rc = stream(f"from explRL.clue_rl import trainRL; from explRL.coop_grid import rl13Config; "
                f"print(trainRL(rl13Config({arm!r}, {seed}, {str(WARM)!r}, {str(d)!r})))")
    print(f'{name}: exit {rc}, {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours', flush=True)
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed (exit {rc}): restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell')
print('all five Phase 13 runs done. Next: Phase 13 evaluation, then Pack.')

title: colab_clue_rl
section: Phase 13 evaluation (gpu; after the five Phase 13 runs; about 2 hours)
text:
Phase 13 evaluation (gpu; after the five Phase 13 runs; about 2 hours)
RL13_PLAN’s evaluation on Colab: the five new adapters on RL_PLAN’s main, generalisation and liar boards (no cross-play; the Phase 12 warm-start and v2 rows are reused, not rerun). Cross-play for both seeds of the best arm runs on the Mac (demo_rl), which merges it with these rows. Each adapter’s rows are saved to Drive when it finishes, so after a disconnect a rerun continues with the next one. Then run Pack.

import numpy as np
from explRL.bench_grid import writeCSV
from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels
from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter
from explRL.coop_grid import RL13_RUNS, rl13Name, rl13Suite
assert RL13_PLAN['frozen'], 'the evaluation uses the frozen RL13_PLAN'
WARM = OUT / 'warm_model'
if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    mergeAdapter(BASE, OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter', WARM)
E13 = OUT / 'eval_p13'
names = [rl13Name(a, s) for a, s in RL13_RUNS]
models = {m: (str(WARM), str(RUNS13 / m / 'final')) for m in names}
t0 = time.time()
rows = evalModels(rl13Suite(names), models, E13, cache='/content/evalcache', logDir=E13 / 'turns')
writeCSV(rows, E13 / 'runs.csv')
for m in names:
    w = [float(r['welfare']) for r in rows if r['level'] == f'{m}|main']
    print(f"{m:12s} main boards: welfare per agent-turn {np.mean(w):.3f} ({len(w)} boards)")
print(f'{len(rows)} boards in all; this session {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours. Next: Pack.')

title: colab_clue_rl
section: Phase 16: runs, evaluation and pack in one session (gpu; about 20 hours; no manual steps)
text:
Phase 16: runs, evaluation and pack in one session (gpu; about 20 hours; no manual steps)
After set-up and configuration, this one cell does all of Phase 16 (RL16_PLAN): (1) trains the six new runs in an interleaved order (individual_s2, indpen_s3, individual_s3, indpen_s4, individual_s4, indpen_s5), each in its own Python process so its GPU memory (vLLM’s engine included) is freed when it ends; (2) evaluates the six adapters on the 15 main boards in its own process; (3) writes explRL_rl16.zip (runs_p16, eval_p16; Phase 13’s explRL_rl.zip is left as it is) to Google Drive; (4) prints each adapter’s welfare, clues shared per clue held and solo share. Finished or halted runs and evaluated adapters are skipped, and an unfinished run resumes from its last checkpoint, so after a disconnect: restart, set-up, configuration, then this cell again. A 20-hour batch needs background execution (Colab Pro+) or a tab that stays connected.

import os
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile
import numpy as np
from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV
from explRL.rl16_grid import RL16_PLAN, RL16_RUNS, rl16Name
assert RL16_PLAN['frozen'], 'freeze, commit and push RL16_PLAN before the Phase 16 runs'
ORDER = list(RL16_RUNS)                                     # interleaved: individual and indpen alternate
WARM, E16 = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / 'eval_p16'
RESUME = 'restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again (finished steps are skipped)'


def stream(code):
    "Run `code` in a fresh Python process, echoing its output (progress bar included) here; -> its exit code."
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-u', '-c', code], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    while chunk := os.read(p.stdout.fileno(), 4096):
        sys.stdout.write(chunk.decode(errors='replace'))
        sys.stdout.flush()
    return p.wait()


t00 = time.time()
if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    assert stream(f"from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter; mergeAdapter({BASE!r}, {str(OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter')!r}, "
                  f"{str(WARM)!r})") == 0, f'merging the warm-start model failed: {RESUME}'
# 1. training, one process per run
for arm, seed in ORDER:
    name, d = rl16Name(arm, seed), RUNS16 / rl16Name(arm, seed)
    if (d / 'final').exists() or (d / 'halted.json').exists():
        print(f'{name}: already done, skipped')
        continue
    print(f'=== {name} ===', flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    rc = stream(f"from explRL.clue_rl import trainRL; from explRL.rl16_grid import rl16Config; "
                f"print(trainRL(rl16Config({arm!r}, {seed}, {str(WARM)!r}, {str(d)!r})))")
    print(f'{name}: exit {rc}, {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours', flush=True)
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed (exit {rc}): {RESUME}')
names = [rl16Name(a, s) for a, s in ORDER]
missing = [m for m in names if not (RUNS16 / m / 'final').exists()]
if missing:
    raise RuntimeError(f'no final adapter for {missing}: {RESUME}')
for m in names:
    if (RUNS16 / m / 'halted.json').exists():
        print(f"{m}: halted ({json.loads((RUNS16 / m / 'halted.json').read_text())['reason']}); evaluated from its final adapter")
# 2. evaluation, in its own process (adapters already evaluated are read back)
models = {m: (str(WARM), str(RUNS16 / m / 'final')) for m in names}
rc = stream("from explRL.bench_grid import writeCSV; from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.rl16_grid import rl16Suite; "
            f"rows = evalModels(rl16Suite({names!r}), {models!r}, {str(E16)!r}, cache='/content/evalcache', "
            f"logDir={str(E16 / 'turns')!r}); writeCSV(rows, {str(E16 / 'runs.csv')!r}); print(len(rows), 'boards')")
if rc:
    raise RuntimeError(f'evaluation failed (exit {rc}): {RESUME}')
# 3. pack to Google Drive (its own zip: Phase 13's explRL_rl.zip is left as it is)
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT / 'explRL_rl16.zip', 'w') as z:
    for p in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')):
        rel = p.relative_to(OUT)
        if p.is_file() and rel.parts[0] in ('runs_p16', 'eval_p16') and 'ckpt-' not in str(rel):
            z.write(p, rel)
# 4. summary
rows = readCSV(E16 / 'runs.csv')
for m in names:
    rs = [r for r in rows if r['level'] == f'{m}|main']
    v = lambda k: np.nanmean([float(r[k]) for r in rs])
    print(f"{m:14s} welfare {v('welfare'):.3f}  shared per held {v('sharePerHeld'):.2f}  solo {v('soloShare'):.2f}  ({len(rs)} boards)")
print(f"{OUT / 'explRL_rl16.zip'} ({(OUT / 'explRL_rl16.zip').stat().st_size / 1e6:.1f} MB); this session {(time.time() - t00) / 3600:.2f} "
      'hours. Next, on the Mac: download the zip, unzip into results/multiagent/rl/colab/, run demo_rl16 (flag train).')

section: Phase 17 step 0: every trained adapter on the team-size grid (gpu; one cell; about 8 hours)
text:
Phase 17 step 0: every trained adapter on the team-size grid (gpu; one cell; about 8 hours)
The warm start and the 14 Phase 12-16 adapters on teamSizeSuite (clean boards at 4, 8, 16 and 32 agents, and boards with a quarter of the agents liars), 40 turns, in one process; models already evaluated are read back after a disconnect. Writes eval_p17s0/ and explRL_rl17s0.zip. An L4 runtime also works.
Models are claimed one at a time, so two accounts can share step 0 (run the cell on both); models not yet on Drive are skipped; the account that finds all 15 evaluated writes runs.csv and the zip.

from explRL.rl17_grid import STEP0_MODELS, claim
WARM, E0 = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / 'eval_p17s0'
if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    assert stream(f"from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter; mergeAdapter({BASE!r}, {str(OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter')!r}, {str(WARM)!r})") == 0
models = {m: (str(WARM), None if d is None else str(OUT / d / 'final')) for m, d in STEP0_MODELS.items()}
missing = [m for m, (_, a) in models.items() if a and not Path(a).exists()]
if missing:
    print(f'not on Drive yet (Phase 16 still running?): {missing}; rerun this cell later for these')
t0 = time.time()
for m, v in models.items():                                    # one model at a time, claimed, so two accounts can share step 0
    if m in missing or (E0 / f'{m}.csv').exists() or not claim(E0 / 'claims' / m, HOST, TAKEOVER):
        continue
    print(f'=== {m} on {HOST} ===', flush=True)
    rc = stream("from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.rl17_grid import teamSizeSuite; "
                f"evalModels(teamSizeSuite([{m!r}]), {{{m!r}: {v!r}}}, {str(E0)!r}, cache='/content/evalcache', logDir={str(E0 / 'turns')!r})")
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'step 0 failed on {m} (exit {rc}): ' + 'restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again (finished steps are skipped)')
left = [m for m in models if not (E0 / f'{m}.csv').exists()]
if left:
    print(f'step 0 not complete yet: {left} (other account, or not on Drive yet): rerun this cell later')
elif claim(E0 / 'claims' / '_pack', HOST, TAKEOVER):
    assert stream("from explRL.bench_grid import writeCSV; from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.rl17_grid import teamSizeSuite; "
                  f"rows = evalModels(teamSizeSuite({list(models)!r}), {models!r}, {str(E0)!r}); "
                  f"writeCSV(rows, {str(E0 / 'runs.csv')!r}); print(len(rows), 'boards')") == 0       # all read back
    packZip('explRL_rl17s0.zip', ('eval_p17s0',))
print(f'step 0 on {HOST}: {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} hours.')

section: Phase 17 main: claimed runs, then the evaluation (gpu; one cell per account)
text:
Phase 17 main: claimed runs, then the evaluation (gpu; one cell per account)
Run this cell on every Colab account that shares the Drive folder (each with its own HOST). It trains every RL17_RUNS run that is not finished and not claimed by another account, each in its own process (an unfinished run resumes from its last checkpoint). When every run has its final adapter, one account wins the evaluation claim, evaluates all runs on teamSizeSuite and writes explRL_rl17.zip; rerun the cell on any account after the last run finishes. To move a run to another account: stop the first runtime, put the run’s name in TAKEOVER on the other, rerun.
Long runs: with background execution the cell keeps going with the browser closed, but Colab ends a session after about 24 hours, and one run takes days. Runs checkpoint every step, so when a session ends: restart, set-up, configuration, this cell again; the run in progress resumes from its last step, finished runs are skipped, and the batch continues.

from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN, RL17_RUNS, claim
assert RL17_PLAN['frozen'] and RL17_PLAN['recipe'] and RL17_PLAN['userConfirmed'], \
    'freeze RL17_PLAN with the pilot-chosen recipe and the confirmed hours, commit and push first'
WARM, E17 = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / 'eval_p17'
names = [f'{a}_s{s}' for a, s in RL17_RUNS]
for (arm, seed), name in zip(RL17_RUNS, names):
    d = RUNS17 / name
    if (d / 'final').exists():
        print(f'{name}: done')
        continue
    if not claim(d, HOST, TAKEOVER):
        print(f"{name}: held by {json.loads((d / 'claim.json').read_text())['host']}, skipped")
        continue
    print(f'=== {name} on {HOST} ===', flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    rc = stream("from explRL.rl17_train import trainRL17; from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN, rl17Config; "
                f"print(trainRL17(rl17Config({arm!r}, {seed}, {str(WARM)!r}, {str(d)!r}, RL17_PLAN['recipe'])))")
    print(f'{name}: exit {rc}, {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours', flush=True)
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed (exit {rc}): ' + 'restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again (finished steps are skipped)')
pending = [n for n in names if not (RUNS17 / n / 'final').exists()]
if pending:
    print(f'waiting for {pending} (other accounts): rerun this cell after they finish')
elif not claim(E17, HOST, TAKEOVER):
    print(f"the evaluation is held by {json.loads((E17 / 'claim.json').read_text())['host']}")
else:
    models = {n: (str(WARM), str(RUNS17 / n / 'final')) for n in names}
    rc = stream("from explRL.bench_grid import writeCSV; from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.rl17_grid import teamSizeSuite; "
                f"rows = evalModels(teamSizeSuite({names!r}), {models!r}, {str(E17)!r}, cache='/content/evalcache', "
                f"logDir={str(E17 / 'turns')!r}); writeCSV(rows, {str(E17 / 'runs.csv')!r}); print(len(rows), 'boards')")
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'evaluation failed (exit {rc}): ' + 'restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again (finished steps are skipped)')
    packZip('explRL_rl17.zip', ('runs_p17', 'eval_p17'))
    print('Next, on the Mac: download explRL_rl17.zip, unzip into results/multiagent/rl/colab/, run demo_rl17 (flag train).')

section: Phase 18 speed check (gpu; one account; about 1 hour)
text:
Phase 18 speed check (gpu; one account; about 1 hour)
specs/multiagent/phase18/, Part B. Three steps of c18team (team reward on the colony board, two holders per clue, Phase 17’s frozen recipe and mix) with a 4,096-token window, into speed_p18/. Prints seconds per step, the longest prompt plus reply, cut prompts, the proposed training window (maxLenRule) and the projected GPU hours (projectHours18) for RL18_PLAN’s 30 steps (Part B lite, 5 runs): report them on the Mac, where the user confirms them and RL18_PLAN is frozen. Needs RL17_PLAN frozen with its recipe.

from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN
from explRL.rl18_grid import RL18_RUNS, RL18_STEPS, maxLenRule, projectHours18, speedConfig
assert RL17_PLAN['frozen'] and RL17_PLAN['recipe'], 'Part B needs Phase 17\'s frozen recipe'
WARM, SP = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / 'speed_p18'
rc = stream("from explRL.rl17_train import trainRL17; from explRL.rl18_grid import speedConfig; from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN; "
            f"print(trainRL17(speedConfig({str(WARM)!r}, {str(SP)!r}, RL17_PLAN['recipe'])))")
if rc:
    raise RuntimeError(f'speed check failed (exit {rc}): restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again')
m = [json.loads(x) for x in open(SP / 'metrics.jsonl')]
sec = sum(x['rolloutSeconds'] + x['updateSeconds'] for x in m[1:]) / max(1, len(m) - 1)   # step 1 includes engine start-up
longest, cut = max(x['longest'] for x in m), sum(x['cut'] for x in m)
h = projectHours18(sec, RL18_STEPS)
print(f"seconds per step {sec:.0f}; longest prompt plus reply {longest} tokens; cut prompts {cut}; invalid {[round(x['invalid'], 3) for x in m]}")
print(f"proposed maxLen {maxLenRule(longest)}; projected GPU hours at {RL18_STEPS} steps: {h['perRun']:.1f} per run, {h['total']:.0f} for all {len(RL18_RUNS)} runs")

section: Phase 18 main: claimed runs, then the evaluation (gpu; one cell per account)
text:
Phase 18 main: claimed runs, then the evaluation (gpu; one cell per account)
Run this cell on every Colab account that shares the Drive folder (each with its own HOST). It trains every RL18_RUNS run (Part B lite: c18team, 5 seeds, 30 steps) that is not finished and not claimed by another account, each in its own process (an unfinished run resumes from its last checkpoint). When every run has its final adapter, evaluation models (the warm start and the 5 adapters on colonySuite: the colony board, 8 and 32 agents with liars, 5 seeds) are claimed one at a time, so both accounts evaluate in parallel; the account that finds them all evaluated writes runs.csv and explRL_rl18.zip. Rerun the cell on any account when it says others still hold work. To move a run: stop the first runtime, add the run’s name to TAKEOVER on the other, rerun. The same 24-hour session rule as Phase 17.

from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN, claim
from explRL.rl18_grid import RL18_PLAN, RL18_RUNS, adapterReady, rl18Config, runDone
assert RL18_PLAN['frozen'] and RL18_PLAN['userConfirmed'] and RL18_PLAN['steps'] and RL18_PLAN['maxLen'], \
    'freeze RL18_PLAN with the steps, window and confirmed hours (after the speed check), commit and push first'
WARM, E18 = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / 'eval_p18'
names = [f'{a}_s{s}' for a, s in RL18_RUNS]
for (arm, seed), name in zip(RL18_RUNS, names):
    d = RUNS18 / name
    if runDone(d):                                          # halted, or the final adapter's weights saved (not just the folder)
        print(f'{name}: done')
        continue
    if not claim(d, HOST, TAKEOVER):
        print(f"{name}: held by {json.loads((d / 'claim.json').read_text())['host']}, skipped")
        continue
    print(f'=== {name} on {HOST} ===', flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    rc = stream("from explRL.rl17_train import trainRL17; from explRL.rl18_grid import RL18_PLAN, rl18Config; from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN; "
                f"print(trainRL17(rl18Config({arm!r}, {seed}, {str(WARM)!r}, {str(d)!r}, RL17_PLAN['recipe'], RL18_PLAN['steps'], RL18_PLAN['maxLen'])))")
    print(f'{name}: exit {rc}, {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours', flush=True)
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed (exit {rc}): restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again (finished steps are skipped)')
pending = [n for n in names if not runDone(RUNS18 / n)]
if pending:
    print(f'waiting for {pending} (other accounts): rerun this cell after they finish')
else:
    from explRL.rl18_grid import evalAdapter               # a halted run: the checkpoint before its halting streak (RL18_PLAN)
    models = {'warm': (str(WARM), None), **{n: (str(WARM), evalAdapter(RUNS18 / n)) for n in names}}
    print('evaluated adapters:', {n: v[1] for n, v in models.items()})
    for mname, v in models.items():                         # one model at a time, claimed: two accounts share the evaluation
        if v[1] and not adapterReady(v[1]):                # Drive has not delivered the weights here yet
            print(f'{mname}: adapter weights not in {v[1]} yet (still syncing from the other account?): rerun this cell later')
            continue
        if (E18 / f'{mname}.csv').exists() or not claim(E18 / 'claims' / mname, HOST, TAKEOVER):
            continue
        print(f'=== evaluating {mname} on {HOST} ===', flush=True)
        rc = stream("from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.rl18_grid import colonySuite; "
                    f"evalModels(colonySuite([{mname!r}]), {{{mname!r}: {v!r}}}, {str(E18)!r}, cache='/content/evalcache', logDir={str(E18 / 'turns')!r})")
        if rc:
            raise RuntimeError(f'evaluation of {mname} failed (exit {rc}): restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again')
    left = [m for m in models if not (E18 / f'{m}.csv').exists()]
    if left:
        print(f'evaluation not complete yet: {left} (other account): rerun this cell later')
    elif claim(E18 / 'claims' / '_pack', HOST, TAKEOVER):
        assert stream("from explRL.bench_grid import writeCSV; from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.rl18_grid import colonySuite; "
                      f"rows = evalModels(colonySuite({list(models)!r}), {models!r}, {str(E18)!r}); "
                      f"writeCSV(rows, {str(E18 / 'runs.csv')!r}); print(len(rows), 'boards')") == 0       # all read back
        packZip('explRL_rl18.zip', ('runs_p18', 'eval_p18'))
        print('Next, on the Mac: download explRL_rl18.zip, unzip into results/multiagent/rl/colab/, run demo_rl18 (flag train).')

title: colab_clue_rl
section: Phase 19 speed check (gpu; one account; about 1 hour)
text:
Phase 19 speed check (gpu; one account; about 1 hour)
specs/multiagent/phase19/, T6. Three steps of arm 2 (a19contest: contest credit for the guards, the varied threat) at 16 agents in squads of 4 and in squads of 8, in SPEED19’s world (squads joined by bridges; squads without cross-squad subtasks only if Gate C1 failed), with a 4,096-token window, into speed_p19/; then the warm start on every training board type (5 boards each), with 4 guards (arms 1-3) and without guards (arm 4), for WARM_ANSWERS. Prints seconds per step, the longest prompt plus reply and a bridge agent’s longest (it reads its own squad’s board and its pair’s mirror lines, P20-3; the 3,072 window is refused if either exceeds it), invalid replies, WARM_ANSWERS per squad size and the projected hours (projectHours19). Read the account’s compute units per A100 hour from Colab’s Resources panel. Report everything on the Mac and wait: the user confirms the pilot. Needs SPEED19 frozen and Gate C1 recorded in RL19_PLAN['gates'], with SPEED19’s world matching it. Rerun after a disconnect: finished parts are skipped.

from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV, writeCSV
from explRL.rl18_grid import runDone
from explRL.rl19_grid import RL19_PLAN, SPEED19, projectHours19, worldFor19
from explRL.rl19_suite import warmTable
assert SPEED19['frozen'], 'freeze SPEED19 (T6), commit and push first'
C1 = RL19_PLAN['gates']['C1']
assert C1 is not None and SPEED19['world'] == worldFor19(C1), "record Gate C1 in RL19_PLAN['gates'] (A1 waits for C1, P19-1) and set SPEED19's world to match it"
WARM, SP = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / SPEED19['dir']
res = {}
for S in SPEED19['squads']:
    d = SP / f'squads{S}'
    if not runDone(d):
        rc = stream("from explRL.rl17_train import trainRL19; from explRL.rl19_grid import speedConfig19; from explRL.rl17_grid import RL17_PLAN; "
                    f"print(trainRL19(speedConfig19({str(WARM)!r}, {str(d)!r}, RL17_PLAN['recipe'], {S})))")
        if rc:
            raise RuntimeError(f'speed check (squads of {S}) failed (exit {rc}): restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again')
    wcsv = SP / f'warm{S}.csv'
    if not wcsv.exists():
        rc = stream("from explRL.bench_grid import writeCSV; from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.rl19_suite import warmCells; "
                    f"rows = evalModels(warmCells({S}, 4) + warmCells({S}, 0), {{'warm': ({str(WARM)!r}, None)}}, {str(SP / f'warm{S}')!r}, cache='/content/evalcache'); "
                    f"writeCSV(rows, {str(wcsv)!r})")
        if rc:
            raise RuntimeError(f'WARM_ANSWERS rollouts (squads of {S}) failed (exit {rc}): restart, set-up, configuration, this cell again')
    m = [json.loads(x) for x in open(d / 'metrics.jsonl')]
    sec = sum(x['rolloutSeconds'] + x['updateSeconds'] for x in m[1:]) / max(1, len(m) - 1)   # step 1 includes engine start-up
    if SPEED19['world'] == 'bridges':
        assert all('longestBridge' in x for x in m), 'bridged rollouts must log longestBridge (a bridge agent\'s longest prompt plus reply)'
    res[S] = dict(stepSeconds=sec, longest=max(x['longest'] for x in m), longestBridge=max(x.get('longestBridge', 0) for x in m),
                  cut=sum(x['cut'] for x in m), invalid=[round(x['invalid'], 4) for x in m],
                  warmAnswers={g: warmTable(readCSV(wcsv), g) for g in SPEED19['warmGuards']})
    fits = max(res[S]['longest'], res[S]['longestBridge']) <= SPEED19['window']
    print(f"squads of {S}: {sec:.0f} s per step; longest prompt plus reply {res[S]['longest']} tokens, a bridge agent's {res[S]['longestBridge']} "
          f"(window {SPEED19['window']}: {'fits' if fits else 'EXCEEDED, refused'}); invalid {res[S]['invalid']}")
    print(f"  WARM_ANSWERS[{S}] = {res[S]['warmAnswers']}")
    h = projectHours19(sec)
    print(f"  projected A100 hours: {h['perRun']:.1f} per run, training {h['training']:.0f}, pilot {h['pilot']:.1f}, evaluation {h['evaluation']:.0f}, total {h['total']:.0f}")
(SP / 'speed.json').write_text(json.dumps({str(k): v for k, v in res.items()}, indent=1) + '\n')
print('Next, on the Mac: record these, WARM_ANSWERS and the compute units per A100 hour (Resources panel); the user confirms the pilot.')

title: colab_clue_rl
section: Phase 19 main: claimed runs, then the evaluation and the pack (gpu; one cell per account)
text:
Phase 19 main: claimed runs, then the evaluation and the pack (gpu; one cell per account)
T8. Trains every RL19_PLAN run (29: arms 1-3 with 8 seeds, arm 4 with 5, 30 steps) that is not finished and not claimed by another account, each in its own process, into runs_p19/ (checkpoints every step; a run resumes from its last), in RL19_PLAN’s world (squads joined by bridges; squads without cross-squad subtasks only if Gate C1 failed). Stability check: the cell trains only the first 2 runs and stops when they finish, printing their halts (the answer halt included). Check them on the Mac; if neither halted, set STABLE19 = True (configuration cell) and rerun to train the rest; if either halted, stop and ask. When every run is done, evaluation models (the warm start and each run’s adapter: evalAdapter19, the checkpoint before a halting streak) are claimed one at a time on contestSuite (the gate grid, the held-out tests, and arm 4’s and the warm start’s sequences) into eval_p19/; then the best arm (Gate A1 as frozen) is evaluated in 64-agent squads joined by bridges (the cell refuses this until bridged rollouts exist), and the last account writes runs.csv and explRL_rl19.zip. Needs RL19_PLAN frozen, with the user’s confirmation of the hours, and Gate C1 recorded with the plan’s world matching it. Rerun on any account when it says others still hold work.

from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV, writeCSV
from explRL.rl17_grid import claim
from explRL.rl18_grid import adapterReady, runDone
from explRL.rl19_grid import RL19_PLAN, evalAdapter19, needWorld19, worldFor19
assert RL19_PLAN['frozen'] and RL19_PLAN['userConfirmed'] and RL19_PLAN['squads'] and RL19_PLAN['warmAnswers'] and RL19_PLAN['records'] is not None, \
    'freeze RL19_PLAN (the pilot\'s squad size, P19-5\'s records, WARM_ANSWERS, the confirmed hours), commit and push first'
C1 = RL19_PLAN['gates']['C1']
assert C1 is not None and RL19_PLAN['world'] == worldFor19(C1), "record Gate C1 in RL19_PLAN['gates'] (P19-1) and set RL19_PLAN's world to match it"
STABLE19 = globals().get('STABLE19', False)   # True (configuration cell) once the first 2 runs passed the stability check (T8)
WARM, R19, E19 = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / 'runs_p19', OUT / 'eval_p19'
S19, runs = RL19_PLAN['squads'], [tuple(r) for r in RL19_PLAN['runs']]
names = [f'{a}_s{s}' for a, s in runs]
first = names[:2]
over = {'turnFraction': RL19_PLAN['turnFraction']} if RL19_PLAN['turnFraction'] else {}
for (arm, seed), name in zip(runs, names):
    d = R19 / name
    if runDone(d):
        print(f'{name}: done')
        continue
    if name not in first and not STABLE19:
        break                                                   # the stability check comes first
    if not claim(d, HOST, TAKEOVER):
        print(f"{name}: held by {json.loads((d / 'claim.json').read_text())['host']}, skipped")
        continue
    print(f'=== {name} on {HOST} ===', flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    rc = stream("from explRL.rl17_train import trainRL19; from explRL.rl19_grid import RL19_PLAN, rl19Config; "
                f"print(trainRL19(rl19Config({arm!r}, {seed}, {str(WARM)!r}, {str(d)!r}, RL19_PLAN['recipe'], {S19}, dict(RL19_PLAN['warmAnswers'])[{S19}], "
                f"steps=RL19_PLAN['steps'], maxLen=RL19_PLAN['maxLen'], **{over!r})))")
    print(f'{name}: exit {rc}, {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.2f} GPU hours', flush=True)
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed (exit {rc}): restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again (finished steps are skipped)')
pending = [n for n in names if not runDone(R19 / n)]
if not STABLE19 and not [n for n in first if n in pending]:
    for n in first:
        h = R19 / n / 'halted.json'
        print(f"{n}: {'halted: ' + json.loads(h.read_text())['reason'] if h.exists() else 'finished without a halt'}")
    print('Stability check: if neither run halted, set STABLE19 = True in the configuration cell and rerun this cell; if either halted, stop and ask.')
models = {'warm': (str(WARM), None), **{n: (str(WARM), evalAdapter19(R19 / n)) for n in names}}
evalCode = ("from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.rl19_suite import contestSuite, evalSequences; from explRL.rl19_grid import RL19_PLAN; "
            "c = [x for x in contestSuite({ms!r}, {S}, best={best!r}, records=RL19_PLAN['records']) if {keep!r} in x['level']]; "
            "evalModels([x for x in c if 'seq' not in x], {mv!r}, {out!r}, cache='/content/evalcache', logDir={log!r}); "
            "evalSequences(c, {mv!r}, {out!r}, cache='/content/evalcache', logDir={log!r})")


def evaluate(stage, todo, best=(), keep=''):
    "Claim and evaluate each model of `todo` once (its cells whose level contains `keep`); -> the models not finished yet (by any account)."
    out, left = E19 / stage, []
    for mname in todo:
        v = models[mname]
        if v[1] and not adapterReady(v[1]):
            print(f'{mname}: adapter weights not here yet (Drive still syncing?)')
            left.append(mname)
            continue
        if (out / 'done' / mname).exists():
            continue
        if not claim(E19 / 'claims' / stage / mname, HOST, TAKEOVER):
            left.append(mname)
            continue
        print(f'=== {stage}: evaluating {mname} on {HOST} ===', flush=True)
        rc = stream(evalCode.format(ms=[mname], S=S19, best=list(best), keep=keep, mv={mname: v}, out=str(out), log=str(out / 'turns')))
        if rc:
            raise RuntimeError(f'evaluation of {mname} failed (exit {rc}): restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again')
        (out / 'done').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (out / 'done' / mname).write_text(HOST + '\n')
    return left


if pending:
    print(f'waiting for {pending} (other accounts, or the stability check): rerun this cell after they finish')
elif left := evaluate('grid', list(models)):
    print(f'grid evaluation not complete yet: {left} (other account): rerun this cell later')
else:
    from explRL.rl19_report import rl19Summaries, runNames19
    rows = [r for f in sorted((E19 / 'grid').glob('*.csv')) for r in readCSV(f)]
    halts = {n: json.loads((R19 / n / 'halted.json').read_text())['reason'] if (R19 / n / 'halted.json').exists() else None for n in names}
    S = rl19Summaries(rows, halts=halts)
    print(f"Gate A1 {'passed' if S['gate'] else 'failed'}; best arm {S['best']}: its runs in 64-agent squads joined by bridges (descriptive)")
    needWorld19('bridges')                                      # the 64-agent squads need bridged rollouts (Phase 20)
    bestRuns = runNames19(S['best'], runs)
    if left := evaluate('big64', ['warm'] + bestRuns, best=bestRuns, keep='64'):
        print(f'64-agent evaluation not complete yet: {left} (other account): rerun this cell later')
    elif claim(E19 / 'claims' / '_pack', HOST, TAKEOVER):
        allRows = rows + [r for f in sorted((E19 / 'big64').glob('*.csv')) for r in readCSV(f) if '64' in r['level']]
        writeCSV(allRows, E19 / 'runs.csv')
        (E19 / 'halts.json').write_text(json.dumps(halts, indent=1) + '\n')
        packZip('explRL_rl19.zip', ('runs_p19', 'eval_p19'))
        print('Next, on the Mac: download explRL_rl19.zip, unzip into results/multiagent/rl/colab/, run demo_rl19 (flag train).')

section: Phase 20: part b and the 3B bridge check (gpu; one cell, one or two accounts; about 5.5 A100 hours)
text:
Phase 20: part b and the 3B bridge check (gpu; one cell, one or two accounts; about 5.5 A100 hours)
specs/multiagent/phase20/, T7 (experiment C1). Part b (P20-10): the warm start and Phase 17’s 8 r17mix adapters, the final weights as published (runs_p17/<run>/final), on squadEvalSuite: 32 agents in squads of 4 on Phase 17’s plain board, seeds 900-909, clean and with 8 scripted liars (one per squad), 40 turns, notes memory (180 boards, levels <model>|n32sq4 and <model>|n32sq4liar), into eval_c1b/. The one-board arm is not rerun: the Mac reads it from eval_p17 and eval_p17s0/warm.csv (reusedPartB). Bridge check (P20-11): the warm start in A1’s world (16 agents, counting board, 4 guards, 4 liars, one bridge per pair) in squads of 8 and of 4, seeds 900-904 (bridgeCheckCells, 10 boards), then the longest prompt per role (bridge, mirror holder, other: bridgePromptTokens with the model’s tokenizer) into check_c1/. Models are claimed one at a time (HOST, TAKEOVER as in Phase 17), so two accounts can share the work; finished models are read back after a disconnect. The account that finds all done writes runs.csv and explRL_c1b.zip. Needs Phase 17’s runs on this Drive; no plan freeze (part b and the check are descriptive, and C1’s pilot and main run are on the Mac).

from explRL.bench_grid import readCSV, writeCSV
from explRL.bridge_grid import PARTB_MODELS, bridgeCheckCells, projectHours20, squadEvalSuite
from explRL.coop_grid import coopHash
from explRL.rl17_grid import claim
from explRL.rl18_grid import adapterReady
WARM, EB, EC = OUT / 'warm_model', OUT / 'eval_c1b', OUT / 'check_c1'
RESUME = 'restart the session, run set-up and configuration, then this cell again (finished models are skipped)'
print(f"part b {coopHash([c['cfg'] for c in squadEvalSuite()])}, check {coopHash([c['cfg'] for c in bridgeCheckCells()])}; "
      f"projected A100 hours {projectHours20()['hours']}")
if not (WARM / 'config.json').exists():
    assert stream(f"from explRL.clue_sft import mergeAdapter; mergeAdapter({BASE!r}, {str(OUT / 'warm' / 'adapter')!r}, {str(WARM)!r})") == 0
models = {'warm': (str(WARM), None), **{m: (str(WARM), str(RUNS17 / m / 'final')) for m in PARTB_MODELS[1:]}}   # final, as published (P20-10)
# 1. part b: each model in squads of 4 (squadEvalSuite), claimed one at a time, so two accounts can share it
for m, v in models.items():
    if (EB / f'{m}.csv').exists():
        continue
    if v[1] and not adapterReady(v[1]):
        print(f'{m}: adapter weights not in {v[1]} (Drive still syncing, or Phase 17 not on this Drive): rerun this cell later')
        continue
    if not claim(EB / 'claims' / m, HOST, TAKEOVER):
        continue
    print(f'=== part b: {m} on {HOST} ===', flush=True)
    rc = stream("from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.bridge_grid import squadEvalSuite; "
                f"evalModels(squadEvalSuite([{m!r}]), {{{m!r}: {v!r}}}, {str(EB)!r}, cache='/content/evalcache', logDir={str(EB / 'turns')!r})")
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'part b failed on {m} (exit {rc}): {RESUME}')
# 2. the 3B bridge check (P20-11): the warm start in A1's world, squads of 8 and 4, then its longest prompt per role
if not (EC / 'prompts.json').exists() and claim(EC / 'claims' / 'warm', HOST, TAKEOVER):
    print(f'=== bridge check on {HOST} ===', flush=True)
    rc = stream("import json; from explRL.clue_roll import evalModels; from explRL.bridge_grid import bridgeCheckCells; "
                "from explRL.bridge_agents import bridgePromptTokens; from explRL.llm_runs import LLMConfig; from explRL.local_policy import LocalPolicy; "
                f"evalModels(bridgeCheckCells(), {{'warm': {models['warm']!r}}}, {str(EC)!r}, cache='/content/evalcache', logDir={str(EC / 'turns')!r}); "
                f"pol = LocalPolicy({str(WARM)!r}, cache='/content/evalcache'); cs = bridgeCheckCells(); "
                "out = {S: bridgePromptTokens(LLMConfig.fromDict([c for c in cs if c['cfg']['world']['squads'] == S][0]['cfg']), "
                "[c['seed'] for c in cs if c['cfg']['world']['squads'] == S], tok=pol.tok(), policy=pol) for S in (8, 4)}; "
                f"open({str(EC / 'prompts.json')!r}, 'w').write(json.dumps(out) + '\\n'); print('longest prompt per role', out)")
    if rc:
        raise RuntimeError(f'bridge check failed (exit {rc}): {RESUME}')
# 3. pack: the account that finds every model and the check done writes runs.csv and explRL_c1b.zip
left = [m for m in models if not (EB / f'{m}.csv').exists()] + ([] if (EC / 'prompts.json').exists() else ['bridge check'])
if left:
    print(f'Phase 20 not complete yet: {left} (other account, or not on Drive yet): rerun this cell later')
elif claim(EB / 'claims' / '_pack', HOST, TAKEOVER):
    rows = [r for m in models for r in readCSV(EB / f'{m}.csv')]
    check = readCSV(EC / 'warm.csv')
    assert len(rows) == 180 and len(check) == 10, (len(rows), len(check))
    writeCSV(rows, EB / 'runs.csv')
    writeCSV(check, EC / 'runs.csv')
    packZip('explRL_c1b.zip', ('eval_c1b', 'check_c1'))
    for lv in ('n32sq4', 'n32sq4liar'):
        print(lv, {m: round(sum(float(r['welfare']) for r in rows if r['level'] == f'{m}|{lv}') / 10, 3) for m in models})
    print('bridge check, longest prompt per role:', json.loads((EC / 'prompts.json').read_text()))
    print('Next, on the Mac: download explRL_c1b.zip, unzip into results/multiagent/rl/colab/, run demo_c1 part b.')
